struct Tok
    kind int
    text str

struct Item
    kind int
    text str

struct P
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    out List[Item]

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok]?
    cs := line.chars()
    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i + 1
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    toks

fn P.peek(self, s str) bool
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return false
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    t.kind == 2 and t.text == s

fn P.expr(mut self) bool
    if not self.term()
        return false
    while self.peek("+") or self.peek("-")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.term()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 2, text: op))
    true

fn P.term(mut self) bool
    if not self.unary()
        return false
    while self.peek("*") or self.peek("/") or self.peek("%")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.unary()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 2, text: op))
    true

fn P.unary(mut self) bool
    if self.peek("-")
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.unary()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 3, text: "-"))
        return true
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return false
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 0
        self.pos += 1
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 0, text: t.text))
        return true
    if t.kind == 1
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return false
        self.pos += 1
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 1, text: t.text))
        return true
    if self.peek("(")
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.expr()
            return false
        if not self.peek(")")
            return false
        self.pos += 1
        return true
    false

fn evaluate(items List[Item], env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    mut st := List[int]()
    for it in items
        if it.kind == 0
            v := it.text.to_int() else return "overflow"
            st.push(v)
        elif it.kind == 1
            st.push(env[it.text])
        elif it.kind == 3
            a := st.pop() else return "syntax"
            r := (0).checked_sub(a) else return "overflow"
            st.push(r)
        else
            b := st.pop() else return "syntax"
            a := st.pop() else return "syntax"
            op := it.text
            if op == "+"
                r := a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            elif op == "-"
                r := a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            elif op == "*"
                r := a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if b == -1 and a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                    return "overflow"
                if op == "/"
                    st.push(a / b)
                else
                    st.push(a % b)
    st.pop() else return "syntax"

# returns an error message or "" on success
fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int], out List[str]) str
    toks := tokenize(line) else return "syntax"
    if toks.len() == 0
        return ""
    mut start := 1
    mut target := ""
    first := toks[0]
    if first.kind != 1
        return "syntax"
    is_let := first.text == "let"
    if is_let
        if toks.len() < 4
            return "syntax"
        t := toks[1]
        if t.kind != 1 or t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        if not (toks[2].kind == 2 and toks[2].text == "=")
            return "syntax"
        target = t.text
        start = 3
    elif first.text != "print"
        return "syntax"
    mut p := P(toks: toks, pos: start, out: List[Item]())
    if not p.expr()
        return "syntax"
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for it in p.out
        if it.kind == 1 and not env.contains(it.text)
            return "unknown {it.text}"
    v := evaluate(p.out, env) else err
        return err
    if is_let
        env[target] = v
    else
        out.push("{v}")
    ""

fn main() !
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        mut out := List[str]()
        msg := run_line(line, mut vars, out)
        for o in out
            print(o)
        if msg != ""
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {msg}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

enum Expr
    Num(v int)
    Big
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

struct Tok
    kind str
    text str

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "end"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == "op"
        return t.text
    t.kind

fn Parser.primary(mut self) Expr ! str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    self.pos += 1
    if t.kind == "num"
        n := t.text.to_int() else return Expr.Big
        return Expr.Num(v: n)
    if t.kind == "name"
        return Expr.Var(name: t.text)
    if t.text == "-"
        e := self.primary()?
        return Expr.Neg(e: e)
    if t.text == "("
        e := self.sum()?
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return e
    "syntax"

fn Parser.term(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.primary()?
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.primary()?
        l = Expr.Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.sum(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.term()?
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = Expr.Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    cs := line.chars()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c.is_digit()
            mut j := i
            mut s := ""
            while j < cs.len() and cs[j].is_digit()
                s = "{s}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: s))
            i = j
        elif c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'
            mut j := i
            mut s := ""
            while j < cs.len() and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or cs[j].is_digit() or cs[j] == '_')
                s = "{s}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            kind := if s == "let" or s == "print" then "kw" else "name"
            out.push(Tok(kind: kind, text: s))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn eval(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    match e
        Num(v) => v
        Big => "overflow"
        Var(name) => env[name]
        Neg(x) =>
            v := eval(x, env)?
            v.checked_sub(0) else return "overflow"
            0.checked_sub(v) else return "overflow"
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                return a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
            if op == "-"
                return a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
            if op == "*"
                return a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
            if b == 0
                return "division by zero"
            if op == "/"
                return a.checked_div(b) else return "overflow"
            if b == -1
                if a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                    return "overflow"
                return 0
            a % b

fn run_line(line str, env Map[str, int]) int? ! str
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return none
    mut start := 1
    mut target := ""
    if toks[0].kind != "kw"
        return "syntax"
    is_let := toks[0].text == "let"
    if is_let
        if toks.len() < 3 or toks[1].kind != "name" or toks[2].text != "="
            return "syntax"
        if toks[2].kind != "op"
            return "syntax"
        target = toks[1].text
        start = 3
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks[start..toks.len()], pos: 0)
    e := p.sum()?
    if p.pos != p.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for t in p.toks
        if t.kind == "name" and not env.contains(t.text)
            return "unknown {t.text}"
    v := eval(e, env)?
    if is_let
        env[target] = v
        return none
    v

fn main() !
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        r := run_line(line, vars) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            failed = true
            continue
        if v := r
            print(v)
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

error enum CalcErr
    Syntax "syntax"
    Unknown(name str) "unknown {name}"
    Overflow "overflow"
    DivZero "division by zero"

enum Expr
    Num(text str)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[str] ! CalcErr
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return Syntax
    out

fn is_num_tok(t str) bool
    t.len() > 0 and is_digit(t.char_at(0) else 'x')

fn is_name_tok(t str) bool
    t.len() > 0 and is_lower(t.char_at(0) else '0') and t != "let" and t != "print"

fn peek(toks List[str], pos int) str
    if pos < toks.len()
        return toks[pos]
    ""

fn parse_atom(toks List[str], mut pos int) Expr ! CalcErr
    t := peek(toks, pos)
    if t == "-"
        pos += 1
        e := parse_atom(toks, mut pos)?
        return Neg(e: e)
    if t == "("
        pos += 1
        e := parse_sum(toks, mut pos)?
        if peek(toks, pos) != ")"
            return Syntax
        pos += 1
        return e
    if is_num_tok(t)
        pos += 1
        return Num(text: t)
    if is_name_tok(t)
        pos += 1
        return Var(name: t)
    Syntax

fn parse_term(toks List[str], mut pos int) Expr ! CalcErr
    mut l := parse_atom(toks, mut pos)?
    while peek(toks, pos) == "*" or peek(toks, pos) == "/" or peek(toks, pos) == "%"
        op := peek(toks, pos)
        pos += 1
        r := parse_atom(toks, mut pos)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn parse_sum(toks List[str], mut pos int) Expr ! CalcErr
    mut l := parse_term(toks, mut pos)?
    while peek(toks, pos) == "+" or peek(toks, pos) == "-"
        op := peek(toks, pos)
        pos += 1
        r := parse_term(toks, mut pos)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn first_unknown(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) str?
    match e
        Num(t) => none
        Var(n) =>
            if env.contains(n)
                none
            else
                n
        Neg(x) => first_unknown(x, env)
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := first_unknown(l, env)
            if a != none
                a
            else
                first_unknown(r, env)

fn eval(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) int ! CalcErr
    match e
        Num(t) =>
            n := t.to_int() else return Overflow
            n
        Var(n) => env[n]
        Neg(x) =>
            v := eval(x, env)?
            r := 0.checked_sub(v) else return Overflow
            r
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                x := a.checked_add(b) else return Overflow
                return x
            if op == "-"
                x := a.checked_sub(b) else return Overflow
                return x
            if op == "*"
                x := a.checked_mul(b) else return Overflow
                return x
            if b == 0
                return DivZero
            if b == -1 and a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                return Overflow
            if op == "/"
                return a / b
            a % b

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! CalcErr
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return
    if toks[0] == "print"
        mut pos := 1
        e := parse_sum(toks, mut pos)?
        if pos != toks.len()
            return Syntax
        u := first_unknown(e, env)
        if u != none
            return Unknown(name: u else "")
        v := eval(e, env)?
        print(v)
        return
    if toks[0] == "let" and toks.len() >= 3 and is_name_tok(toks[1]) and toks[2] == "="
        mut pos := 3
        e := parse_sum(toks, mut pos)?
        if pos != toks.len()
            return Syntax
        u := first_unknown(e, env)
        if u != none
            return Unknown(name: u else "")
        v := eval(e, env)?
        env[toks[1]] = v
        return
    return Syntax

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        run_line(line, mut vars) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")

    if failed

error enum EvalErr
    Overflow "overflow"
    DivZero "division by zero"

struct Tok
    kind int
    text str

struct Item
    kind int
    text str

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    out List[Item]

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok]?
    cs := line.chars()
    toks := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i + 1
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: line.slice(i, i + 1)))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    toks

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return ""
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 2
        return t.text
    ""

fn Parser.expr(mut self) bool
    if not self.term()
        return false
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.term()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 3, text: op))
    true

fn Parser.term(mut self) bool
    if not self.unary()
        return false
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.unary()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 3, text: op))
    true

fn Parser.unary(mut self) bool
    if self.peek() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.unary()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 2, text: "-"))
        return true
    if self.peek() == "("
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.expr()
            return false
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return false
        self.pos += 1
        return true
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return false
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 0
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 0, text: t.text))
    elif t.kind == 1 and t.text != "let" and t.text != "print"
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 1, text: t.text))
    else
        return false
    self.pos += 1
    true

fn apply(op str, a int, b int) int ! EvalErr
    if op == "+"
        return a.checked_add(b) else return Overflow
    if op == "-"
        return a.checked_sub(b) else return Overflow
    if op == "*"
        return a.checked_mul(b) else return Overflow
    if b == 0
        return DivZero
    if b == -1 and a == int.MIN
        return Overflow
    if op == "/"
        return a / b
    a % b

fn eval(items List[Item], env Map[str, int]) int ! EvalErr
    st := List[int]()
    for it in items
        if it.kind == 0
            n := it.text.to_int() else return Overflow
            st.push(n)
        elif it.kind == 1
            st.push(env[it.text])
        elif it.kind == 2
            a := st.pop() else 0
            st.push(a.checked_neg() else return Overflow)
        else
            b := st.pop() else 0
            a := st.pop() else 0
            st.push(apply(it.text, a, b)?)
    st[0]

# returns an error message, or "" on success
fn run_line(line str, env mut Map[str, int]) str
    toks := tokenize(line) else return "syntax"
    if toks.len() == 0
        return ""
    first := toks[0]
    if first.kind == 1 and first.text == "#"
        return ""
    mut start := 1
    mut name := ""
    if first.kind == 1 and first.text == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3
            return "syntax"
        n := toks[1]
        if n.kind != 1 or n.text == "let" or n.text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        if toks[2].kind != 2 or toks[2].text != "="
            return "syntax"
        name = n.text
        start = 3
    elif first.kind == 1 and first.text == "print"
        start = 1
    else
        return "syntax"
    p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: start, out: List[Item]())
    mut q := p
    if not q.expr() or q.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for it in q.out
        if it.kind == 1 and not env.contains(it.text)
            return "unknown {it.text}"
    v := eval(q.out, env) else err

    DivZero "division by zero"

    kind int
    text str

struct Item
    kind int
    text str

    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    out List[Item]

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok]?
    cs := line.chars()
    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i + 1
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: line.slice(i, i + 1)))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    toks

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return ""
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 2
        return t.text
    ""

fn Parser.expr(mut self) bool
    if not self.term()
        return false
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.term()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 3, text: op))
    true

fn Parser.term(mut self) bool
    if not self.unary()
        return false
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.unary()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 3, text: op))
    true

fn Parser.unary(mut self) bool
    if self.peek() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.unary()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 2, text: "-"))
        return true
    if self.peek() == "("
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.expr()
            return false
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return false
        self.pos += 1
        return true
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()

        return false
    self.pos += 1

    if op == "+"

    if op == "-"

struct Tok
    kind int
    s str

struct Node
    kind int
    s str
    l int
    r int

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    nodes List[Node]

fn maxv() int
    9223372036854775807

fn minv() int
    -9223372036854775807 - 1

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i].code()
        if c == 32
            i += 1
        elif c >= 48 and c <= 57
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < n and cs[j].code() >= 48 and cs[j].code() <= 57
                t = "{t}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 0, s: t))
            i = j
        elif c >= 97 and c <= 122
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < n and ((cs[j].code() >= 97 and cs[j].code() <= 122) or (cs[j].code() >= 48 and cs[j].code() <= 57) or cs[j].code() == 95)
                t = "{t}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 1, s: t))
            i = j
        elif c == 43 or c == 45 or c == 42 or c == 47 or c == 37 or c == 40 or c == 41 or c == 61
            out.push(Tok(kind: 2, s: "{cs[i]}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return ""
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 2
        return t.s
    ""

fn Parser.add(mut self, n Node) int
    self.nodes.push(n)
    self.nodes.len() - 1

fn Parser.expr(mut self) int ! str
    mut l := self.term()?
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.toks[self.pos].s
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = self.add(Node(kind: 3, s: op, l: l, r: r))
    l

fn Parser.term(mut self) int ! str
    mut l := self.unary()?
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.toks[self.pos].s
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.unary()?
        l = self.add(Node(kind: 3, s: op, l: l, r: r))
    l

fn Parser.unary(mut self) int ! str
    if self.peek() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.unary()?
        return self.add(Node(kind: 2, s: "", l: e, r: 0))
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 0
        self.pos += 1
        return self.add(Node(kind: 0, s: t.s, l: 0, r: 0))
    if t.kind == 1
        if t.s == "let" or t.s == "print"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return self.add(Node(kind: 1, s: t.s, l: 0, r: 0))
    if t.s == "("
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.expr()?
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return e
    "syntax"

fn parse_num(s str) int ! str
    mut n := 0
    for ch in s.chars()
        d := ch.code() - 48
        if n > (maxv() - d) / 10
            return "overflow"
        n = n * 10 + d
    n

fn eval(nodes List[Node], i int, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    nd := nodes[i]
    if nd.kind == 0
        return parse_num(nd.s)
    if nd.kind == 1
        return env[nd.s]
    if nd.kind == 2
        a := eval(nodes, nd.l, env)?
        if a == minv()
            return "overflow"
        return -a
    a := eval(nodes, nd.l, env)?
    b := eval(nodes, nd.r, env)?
    if nd.s == "+"
        if (b > 0 and a > maxv() - b) or (b < 0 and a < minv() - b)
            return "overflow"
        return a + b
    if nd.s == "-"
        if (b < 0 and a > maxv() + b) or (b > 0 and a < minv() + b)
            return "overflow"
        return a - b
    if nd.s == "*"
        if a == 0 or b == 0
            return 0
        if a > 0 and b > 0 and a > maxv() / b
            return "overflow"
        if a > 0 and b < 0 and b < minv() / a
            return "overflow"
        if a < 0 and b > 0 and a < minv() / b
            return "overflow"
        if a < 0 and b < 0 and a < maxv() / b
            return "overflow"
        return a * b
    if b == 0
        return "division by zero"
    if b == -1 and a == minv()
        return "overflow"
    if nd.s == "/"
        return a / b
    a % b

fn run_line(line str, env Map[str, int]) str ! str
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    mut is_let := false
    mut start := 0
    if toks.len() == 0
        return ""
    if toks[0].kind != 1
        return "syntax"
    if toks[0].s == "let"
        if toks.len() < 4 or toks[1].kind != 1 or toks[2].kind != 2 or toks[2].s != "="
            return "syntax"
        if toks[1].s == "let" or toks[1].s == "print"
            return "syntax"
        is_let = true
        start = 3
    elif toks[0].s == "print"
        start = 1
    else
        return "syntax"
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: start, nodes: List[Node]())
    root := p.expr()?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for nd in p.nodes
        if nd.kind == 1 and not env.contains(nd.s)
            return "unknown {nd.s}"
    v := eval(p.nodes, root, env)?
    if is_let
        env[toks[1].s] = v
        return ""

    r int

    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i].code()
        if c == 32
            i += 1
        elif c >= 48 and c <= 57
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < n and cs[j].code() >= 48 and cs[j].code() <= 57
                t = "{t}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 0, s: t))
            i = j
        elif c >= 97 and c <= 122
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < n and ((cs[j].code() >= 97 and cs[j].code() <= 122) or (cs[j].code() >= 48 and cs[j].code() <= 57) or cs[j].code() == 95)

                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 1, s: t))
            i = j
        elif c == 43 or c == 45 or c == 42 or c == 47 or c == 37 or c == 40 or c == 41 or c == 61
            out.push(Tok(kind: 2, s: "{cs[i]}"))
            i += 1
        else

        return ""
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 2

        op := self.toks[self.pos].s
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = self.add(Node(kind: 3, s: op, l: l, r: r))

    mut l := self.unary()?

enum Tok
    Num(text str)
    Name(text str)
    Op(sym str)

enum Expr
    Lit(text str)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut t := ""
            while i < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[i])
                t = "{t}{cs[i]}"
                i += 1
            out.push(Num(text: t))
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut t := ""
            while i < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[i]) or is_digit(cs[i]) or cs[i] == '_')
                t = "{t}{cs[i]}"
                i += 1
            out.push(Name(text: t))
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Op(sym: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn Parser.peek_op(self, s str) bool
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return false
    match self.toks[self.pos]
        Op(sym) => sym == s
        _ => false

fn Parser.expr(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.term()?
    while self.peek_op("+") or self.peek_op("-")
        op := match self.toks[self.pos]
            Op(sym) => sym
            _ => ""
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.term(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.unary()?
    while self.peek_op("*") or self.peek_op("/") or self.peek_op("%")
        op := match self.toks[self.pos]
            Op(sym) => sym
            _ => ""
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.unary()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.unary(mut self) Expr ! str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    match t
        Op(sym) =>
            if sym == "-"
                self.pos += 1
                e := self.unary()?
                return Neg(e: e)
            if sym == "("
                self.pos += 1
                e := self.expr()?
                if not self.peek_op(")")
                    return "syntax"
                self.pos += 1
                return e
            return "syntax"
        Num(text) =>
            self.pos += 1
            return Lit(text: text)
        Name(text) =>
            if text == "let" or text == "print"
                return "syntax"
            self.pos += 1
            return Var(name: text)

fn first_unknown(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) str?
    match e
        Lit(text) => none
        Var(name) =>
            if env.contains(name)
                none
            else
                name
        Neg(x) => first_unknown(x, env)
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := first_unknown(l, env)
            if a != none
                return a
            first_unknown(r, env)

fn eval(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    match e
        Lit(text) =>
            n := text.to_int() else return "overflow"
            n
        Var(name) => env[name]
        Neg(x) =>
            v := eval(x, env)?
            r := v.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
            r
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                x := a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if op == "-"
                x := a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if op == "*"
                x := a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if b == 0
                return "division by zero"
            if op == "/"
                x := a.checked_div(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            x := a.checked_rem(b) else return "overflow"
            x

fn is_name(t Tok) bool
    match t
        Name(text) => text != "let" and text != "print"
        _ => false

fn run_line(line str, env Map[str, int]) str ! str
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: 0)
    if toks.len() == 0
        return ""
    mut target := ""
    mut is_let := false
    first := toks[0]
    match first
        Name(text) =>
            if text == "let"
                if toks.len() < 3 or not is_name(toks[1]) or not p.toks_eq(2)
                    return "syntax"
                is_let = true
                target = match toks[1]
                    Name(t) => t
                    _ => ""
                p.pos = 3
            elif text == "print"
                p.pos = 1
            else
                return "syntax"
        _ => return "syntax"
    e := p.expr()?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    u := first_unknown(e, env)
    if u != none
        return "unknown {u else ""}"
    v := eval(e, env)?
    if is_let
        env[target] = v
        return ""
    "{v}"

fn Parser.toks_eq(self, i int) bool
    match self.toks[i]
        Op(sym) => sym == "="
        _ => false

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        out := run_line(line, vars) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            failed = true
            continue
        if out != ""
            print(out)
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

error enum CalcError

    Unknown(name str) "unknown {name}"
    Overflow "overflow"
    DivZero "division by zero"

enum Expr
    Num(v int, ok bool)
    Name(n str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[str] ! CalcError
    cs := line.chars()
    mut toks := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            toks.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif "+-*/%()=".contains("{c}")
            toks.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return Syntax
    toks

fn tok_kind(t str) int
    c := t.char_at(0) else ' '
    if is_digit(c)
        return 0
    if is_lower(c)
        if t == "let" or t == "print"
            return 3
        return 1
    2

fn parse_primary(toks List[str], mut pos int) Expr ! CalcError
    if pos >= toks.len()
        return Syntax
    t := toks[pos]
    k := tok_kind(t)
    if k == 0
        pos += 1
        v := t.to_int() else return Num(v: 0, ok: false)
        return Num(v: v, ok: true)
    if k == 1
        pos += 1
        return Name(n: t)
    if t == "("
        pos += 1
        e := parse_expr(toks, mut pos)?
        if pos >= toks.len() or toks[pos] != ")"
            return Syntax
        pos += 1
        return e
    Syntax

fn parse_unary(toks List[str], mut pos int) Expr ! CalcError
    if pos < toks.len() and toks[pos] == "-"
        pos += 1
        e := parse_unary(toks, mut pos)?
        return Neg(e: e)
    parse_primary(toks, mut pos)

fn parse_term(toks List[str], mut pos int) Expr ! CalcError
    mut l := parse_unary(toks, mut pos)?
    while pos < toks.len() and (toks[pos] == "*" or toks[pos] == "/" or toks[pos] == "%")
        op := toks[pos]
        pos += 1
        r := parse_unary(toks, mut pos)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn parse_expr(toks List[str], mut pos int) Expr ! CalcError
    mut l := parse_term(toks, mut pos)?
    while pos < toks.len() and (toks[pos] == "+" or toks[pos] == "-")
        op := toks[pos]
        pos += 1
        r := parse_term(toks, mut pos)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn first_unknown(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) str?
    match e
        Num(v, ok) => none
        Name(n) => if env.contains(n)
            none
        else
            n
        Neg(x) => first_unknown(x, env)
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := first_unknown(l, env)
            if a != none
                return a
            first_unknown(r, env)

fn eval(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) int ! CalcError
    match e
        Num(v, ok) =>
            if not ok
                return Overflow
            v
        Name(n) => env[n]
        Neg(x) =>
            v := eval(x, env)?
            0.checked_sub(v) else return Overflow
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                return a.checked_add(b) else return Overflow
            if op == "-"
                return a.checked_sub(b) else return Overflow
            if op == "*"
                return a.checked_mul(b) else return Overflow
            if b == 0
                return DivZero
            if b == -1
                if a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                    return Overflow
                if op == "/"
                    return 0 - a
                return 0
            if op == "/"
                return a / b
            a % b

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! CalcError
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return
    if toks[0].starts_with("#") 
        return
    mut pos := 0
    mut target := ""
    k := tok_kind(toks[0])
    if toks[0] == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3 or tok_kind(toks[1]) != 1 or toks[2] != "="
            return Syntax
        target = toks[1]
        pos = 3
    elif toks[0] == "print"
        pos = 1
    else
        return Syntax
    e := parse_expr(toks, mut pos)?
    if pos != toks.len()
        return Syntax
    u := first_unknown(e, env)
    if u != none
        return Unknown(name: u else "")
    v := eval(e, env)?
    if target == ""
        print(v)
    else
        env[target] = v

    if env.args().len() > 0

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        match c
            ' ' =>
                i += 1
            '0'..='9' =>
                mut j := i
                while j < n and cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9'
                    j += 1
                toks.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
                i = j
            'a'..='z' =>
                mut j := i
                while j < n and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or (cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9') or cs[j] == '_')
                    j += 1
                toks.push(Tok(kind: "name", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
                i = j
            '+' | '-' | '*' | '/' | '%' | '(' | ')' | '=' =>
                toks.push(Tok(kind: "{c}", text: "{c}"))
                i += 1
            _ =>
                return "syntax"
    toks

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        self.toks[self.pos].kind
    else
        ""

fn Parser.expr(mut self) ! str
    self.term()?
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.toks[self.pos].kind
        self.pos += 1
        self.term()?
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: op, text: op))

fn Parser.term(mut self) ! str
    self.unary()?
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.toks[self.pos].kind
        self.pos += 1
        self.unary()?
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: op, text: op))

fn Parser.unary(mut self) ! str
    if self.peek() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        self.unary()?
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: "neg", text: "neg"))
    else
        self.atom()?

fn Parser.atom(mut self) ! str
    k := self.peek()
    if k == "num" or (k == "name" and self.toks[self.pos].text != "let" and self.toks[self.pos].text != "print")
        self.out.push(self.toks[self.pos])
        self.pos += 1
    elif k == "("
        self.pos += 1
        self.expr()?
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
    else
        return "syntax"

    lo := -9223372036854775807 - 1

                st.push(v)
            "name" =>

                    st.push(a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow")
                elif t.kind == "*"
                    st.push(a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow")
                else
                    if a == lo and b == -1
                        return "overflow"
                    if b == 0
                        return "division by zero"
                    if t.kind == "/"
                        st.push(a / b)
                    else

                return "unknown {t.text}"

        match c

                i += 1
            '0'..='9' =>
                mut j := i
                while j < n and cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9'
                    j += 1
                toks.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
                i = j
            'a'..='z' =>

                while j < n and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or (cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9') or cs[j] == '_')
                    j += 1
                toks.push(Tok(kind: "name", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
                i = j
            '+' | '-' | '*' | '/' | '%' | '(' | ')' | '=' =>
                toks.push(Tok(kind: "{c}", text: "{c}"))
                i += 1
            _ =>
                return "syntax"
    toks

    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        self.toks[self.pos].kind
    else
        ""

    self.term()?
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"

        self.unary()?
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: op, text: op))

    if self.peek() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        self.unary()?
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: "neg", text: "neg"))

        self.atom()?

    k := self.peek()

    out List[Tok]

    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return false
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    t.kind == "op" and t.text == s

fn P.expr(mut self) ! str
    self.term()?
    while self.is_op("+") or self.is_op("-")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        self.term()?
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: "bin", text: op))

fn P.term(mut self) ! str
    self.unary()?
    while self.is_op("*") or self.is_op("/") or self.is_op("%")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        self.unary()?
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: "bin", text: op))

fn P.unary(mut self) ! str
    if self.is_op("-")
        self.pos += 1
        self.unary()?
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: "neg", text: ""))
        return
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == "num"
        self.pos += 1
        self.out.push(t)
    elif t.kind == "name"
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        self.out.push(t)
    elif self.is_op("(")
        self.pos += 1
        self.expr()?
        if not self.is_op(")")
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
    else
        return "syntax"

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

    mut toks := List[Tok]()

    while i < n

        if c == ' '

            toks.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "name", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')'
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "{c}"))

            i += 1
        else

    if (b > 0 and a > MAXV - b) or (b < 0 and a < MINV - b)
        return "overflow"
    a + b

    if (b < 0 and a > MAXV + b) or (b > 0 and a < MINV + b)
        return "overflow"
    a - b

fn mul(a int, b int) int ! str
    if a == 0 or b == 0
        return 0
    if a > 0 and b > 0
        if a > MAXV / b
            return "overflow"
    elif a > 0
        if b < MINV / a
            return "overflow"
    elif b > 0
        if a < MINV / b
            return "overflow"
    else
        if a < MAXV / b
            return "overflow"
    a * b

            else

                if t.text == "/"

        nm := toks[1]

    for t in p.out
        if t.kind == "name" and not vars.contains(t.text)
            return "unknown {t.text}"
    v := evaluate(p.out, vars)?
    if first.text == "let"
        vars[target] = v
    else
        print(v)

fn main()

        io.eprint("usage: calc")

            toks.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    toks

fn is_name(t str) bool
    t != "let" and t != "print" and is_lower(t.chars()[0])

struct Parser
    toks List[str]
    pos int
    run bool

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        self.toks[self.pos]
    else
        ""

fn add_ck(a int, b int) int ! str
    if b > 0 and a > MAXV - b
        return "overflow"
    if b < 0 and a < MINV - b
        return "overflow"
    a + b

fn sub_ck(a int, b int) int ! str
    if b < 0 and a > MAXV + b
        return "overflow"
    if b > 0 and a < MINV + b
        return "overflow"
    a - b

fn mul_ck(a int, b int) int ! str
    if a == 0 or b == 0
        return 0
    if a > 0
        if b > 0 and a > MAXV / b
            return "overflow"
        if b < 0 and b < MINV / a
            return "overflow"
    else
        if b > 0 and a < MINV / b
            return "overflow"
        if b < 0 and a < MAXV / b
            return "overflow"
    a * b

fn Parser.atom(mut self, vars Map[str, int]) int ! str
    t := self.peek()
    if t == ""
        return "syntax"
    if t == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        v := self.atom(vars)?
        if not self.run
            return 0
        if v == MINV
            return "overflow"
        return -v
    if t == "("
        self.pos += 1
        v := self.expr(vars)?
        if self.peek() != ")"

        self.pos += 1
        if not self.run
            return 0
        return vars.get(t) else 0

    mut v := self.atom(vars)?
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.atom(vars)?
        if self.run

    mut v := self.term(vars)?
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"

        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term(vars)?
        if self.run
            if op == "+"
                v = add_ck(v, r)?
            else
                v = sub_ck(v, r)?
    v

    toks := lex(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return
    head := toks[0]
    mut target := ""
    mut start := 1
    if head == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3 or not is_name(toks[1]) or toks[2] != "="
            return "syntax"
        target = toks[1]
        start = 3
    elif head != "print"
        return "syntax"
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: start, run: false)
    p.expr(vars)?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for k in start..toks.len()
        t := toks[k]
        if is_name(t) and not vars.contains(t)
            return "unknown {t}"
    p.pos = start
    p.run = true
    v := p.expr(vars)?
    if target == ""
        print(v)
    else
        vars[target] = v

fn main() !
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        s := line.trim_start()
        if s == "" or s.starts_with("#")
            continue
        exec(line, mut vars) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

MAXV := 9223372036854775807
MINV := -9223372036854775807 - 1

struct Tok
    kind int
    text str

struct Node
    kind int
    op char
    l int
    r int
    num int
    ok bool
    name str

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    nodes List[Node]

fn Parser.peek_is(self, text str) bool
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        t := self.toks[self.pos]
        return t.kind >= 2 and t.text == text
    false

fn Parser.add(mut self, n Node) int
    self.nodes.push(n)
    self.nodes.len() - 1

fn mknode(kind int) Node
    Node(kind: kind, op: ' ', l: 0, r: 0, num: 0, ok: true, name: "")

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    cs := line.chars()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c >= '0' and c <= '9'
            mut j := i
            mut parts := List[str]()
            while j < cs.len() and cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9'
                parts.push("{cs[j]}")
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: parts.join("")))
            i = j
        elif c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'
            mut j := i
            mut parts := List[str]()
            while j < cs.len() and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or (cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9') or cs[j] == '_')
                parts.push("{cs[j]}")
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: parts.join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn parse_primary(mut p Parser) int ! str
    if p.pos >= p.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := p.toks[p.pos]
    if t.kind == 0
        p.pos += 1
        mut n := mknode(0)
        v := t.text.to_int() else none
        if v == none
            n.ok = false
        else
            n.num = v else 0
        return p.add(n)
    if t.kind == 1
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        p.pos += 1
        mut n := mknode(1)
        n.name = t.text
        return p.add(n)
    if t.text == "("
        p.pos += 1
        e := parse_expr(mut p)?
        if not p.peek_is(")")
            return "syntax"
        p.pos += 1
        return e
    "syntax"

fn parse_unary(mut p Parser) int ! str
    if p.peek_is("-")
        p.pos += 1
        e := parse_unary(mut p)?
        mut n := mknode(2)
        n.l = e
        return p.add(n)
    parse_primary(mut p)

fn parse_term(mut p Parser) int ! str
    mut left := parse_unary(mut p)?
    while p.peek_is("*") or p.peek_is("/") or p.peek_is("%")
        opc := p.toks[p.pos].text.char_at(0) else '*'
        p.pos += 1
        r := parse_unary(mut p)?
        mut n := mknode(3)
        n.op = opc
        n.l = left
        n.r = r
        left = p.add(n)
    left

fn parse_expr(mut p Parser) int ! str
    mut left := parse_term(mut p)?
    while p.peek_is("+") or p.peek_is("-")
        opc := p.toks[p.pos].text.char_at(0) else '+'
        p.pos += 1
        r := parse_term(mut p)?
        mut n := mknode(3)
        n.op = opc
        n.l = left
        n.r = r
        left = p.add(n)
    left

fn mul(a int, b int) int ! str
    if a == 0 or b == 0
        return 0
    bad := if a > 0 and b > 0 then a > MAXV / b
        elif a > 0 then b < MINV / a
        elif b > 0 then a < MINV / b
        else a < MAXV / b
    if bad
        return "overflow"
    a * b

fn apply(op char, a int, b int) int ! str
    if op == '+'
        if (b > 0 and a > MAXV - b) or (b < 0 and a < MINV - b)
            return "overflow"
        return a + b
    if op == '-'
        if (b < 0 and a > MAXV + b) or (b > 0 and a < MINV + b)
            return "overflow"
        return a - b
    if op == '*'
        return mul(a, b)?
    if b == 0
        return "division by zero"
    if a == MINV and b == -1
        return "overflow"
    if op == '/'
        return a / b
    a % b

fn eval(p Parser, vars Map[str, int], i int) int ! str
    n := p.nodes[i]
    if n.kind == 0
        if not n.ok
            return "overflow"
        return n.num
    if n.kind == 1
        return vars[n.name]
    if n.kind == 2
        v := eval(p, vars, n.l)?
        if v == MINV
            return "overflow"
        return -v
    a := eval(p, vars, n.l)?
    b := eval(p, vars, n.r)?
    apply(n.op, a, b)?

fn run_line(line str, mut vars Map[str, int]) ! str
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return
    mut start := 1
    mut target := ""
    first := toks[0]
    if first.kind == 1 and first.text == "let"
        if toks.len() < 4
            return "syntax"
        nm := toks[1]
        eq := toks[2]
        if nm.kind != 1 or nm.text == "let" or nm.text == "print" or eq.kind != 2 or eq.text != "="
            return "syntax"
        target = nm.text
        start = 3
    elif first.kind == 1 and first.text == "print"
        start = 1
    else
        return "syntax"
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks.slice(start), pos: 0, nodes: [])
    root := parse_expr(mut p)?
    if p.pos != p.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for n in p.nodes
        if n.kind == 1 and not vars.contains(n.name)
            return "unknown {n.name}"
    v := eval(p, vars, root)?
    if target == ""
        print(v)
    else
        vars[target] = v

fn blank(line str) bool
    for c in line.chars()
        if c == '#'
            return true
        if c != ' '
            return false
    true

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        if blank(line)
            continue
        run_line(line, mut vars) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

    text str

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    out List[Tok]

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok]?
    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    cs := line.chars()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c >= '0' and c <= '9'
            mut j := i
            while j < n and cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9'
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'
            mut j := i
            while j < n and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or (cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9') or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "name", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    toks

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        t := self.toks[self.pos]
        if t.kind == "op"
            return t.text
    ""

fn Parser.unary(mut self) bool
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return false
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == "num" or t.kind == "name"
        self.out.push(t)
        self.pos += 1
        return true
    if t.text == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.unary()
            return false
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "neg"))
        return true
    if t.text == "("
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.expr(0)
            return false
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return false
        self.pos += 1
        return true
    false

fn prec(op str) int
    if op == "+" or op == "-"
        return 1
    if op == "*" or op == "/" or op == "%"
        return 2
    0

fn Parser.expr(mut self, minp int) bool
    if not self.unary()
        return false
    while true
        op := self.peek()
        p := prec(op)
        if p == 0 or p < minp
            break
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.expr(p + 1)
            return false
        self.out.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: op))
    true

    mut st := List[int]()
    for t in rpn
        if t.kind == "num"
            st.push(t.text.to_int() else return "overflow")
        elif t.kind == "name"
            st.push(env[t.text])
        elif t.text == "neg"
            a := st.pop() else 0
            st.push(0.checked_sub(a) else return "overflow")
        else
            b := st.pop() else 0
            a := st.pop() else 0
            r := if t.text == "+"
                a.checked_add(b)
            elif t.text == "-"
                a.checked_sub(b)
            elif t.text == "*"
                a.checked_mul(b)
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if b == -1 and a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                    return "overflow"
                if t.text == "/"
                    a / b
                else
                    a % b
            st.push(r else return "overflow")
    st[0]

fn run_line(line str, env Map[str, int]) str?
    toks := tokenize(line) else return "syntax"
    if toks.len() == 0
        return none
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: 0, out: [])
    first := toks[0]
    mut target := ""
    if first.kind == "name" and first.text == "print"
        p.pos = 1
    elif first.kind == "name" and first.text == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3
            return "syntax"
        nm := toks[1]
        eq := toks[2]
        if nm.kind != "name" or nm.text == "let" or nm.text == "print" or eq.kind != "op" or eq.text != "="
            return "syntax"
        target = nm.text
        p.pos = 3
    else
        return "syntax"
    if not p.expr(0) or p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for t in p.out
        if t.kind == "name"
            if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
                return "syntax"
    for t in p.out
        if t.kind == "name" and not env.contains(t.text)
            return "unknown {t.text}"
    v := eval(p.out, env) else err
        return err
    if target == ""
        print(v)
    else
        env[target] = v
    none

fn main()
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        msg := run_line(line, vars)
        if m := msg
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {m}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        t := self.toks[self.pos]
        if t.kind == 2
            return t.text
    ""

fn P.fail(mut self, e str)
    if self.err == ""
        self.err = e

fn P.atom(mut self) int
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        self.bad = true
        return 0
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    self.pos += 1
    if t.kind == 0
        if self.ev
            return t.text.to_int() else
                self.fail("overflow")
                return 0
        return 0
    if t.kind == 1
        if self.ev
            return self.env.get(t.text) else 0
        return 0
    if t.text == "("
        v := self.expr()
        if self.peek() == ")"
            self.pos += 1
        else
            self.bad = true
        return v
    self.bad = true
    0

fn P.unary(mut self) int
    if self.peek() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        v := self.unary()
        if self.ev and self.err == ""
            if v == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                self.fail("overflow")
                return 0
            return -v
        return 0
    self.atom()

fn P.term(mut self) int
    mut a := self.unary()
    while not self.bad and (self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%")
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        b := self.unary()
        if self.ev and self.err == ""
            if op == "*"
                a = a.checked_mul(b) else
                    self.fail("overflow")
                    0
            elif b == 0
                self.fail("division by zero")
            elif a == -9223372036854775807 - 1 and b == -1
                self.fail("overflow")
            elif op == "/"
                a = a / b
            else
                a = a % b
    a

fn P.expr(mut self) int
    mut a := self.term()
    while not self.bad and (self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-")
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        b := self.term()
        if self.ev and self.err == ""
            if op == "+"
                a = a.checked_add(b) else
                    self.fail("overflow")
                    0
            else
                a = a.checked_sub(b) else
                    self.fail("overflow")
                    0

    head := toks[0].text
    mut start := 1
    mut target := ""
    if head == "let"

            return "syntax"
        if toks[2].kind != 2 or toks[2].text != "="

    p.pos = 0

struct Tok
    kind int
    text str

struct Item
    kind int
    val int
    name str

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    out List[Item]

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok]?
    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    cs := line.chars()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c.is_digit()
            mut j := i
            mut parts := List[str]()
            while j < cs.len() and cs[j].is_digit()
                parts.push("{cs[j]}")
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: parts.join("")))
            i = j
        elif c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'
            mut j := i
            mut parts := List[str]()
            while j < cs.len() and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or cs[j].is_digit() or cs[j] == '_')
                parts.push("{cs[j]}")
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: parts.join("")))
            i = j
        elif "+-*/%()=".contains(c)
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 3, text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    toks

fn Parser.peek_op(self) str
    if pos < toks.len() and toks[pos].kind == 3
        return toks[pos].text
    ""

fn Parser.expr(mut self) bool
    if not self.term()
        return false
    while true
        op := self.peek_op()
        if op == "+" or op == "-"
            self.pos += 1
            if not self.term()
                return false
            self.out.push(Item(kind: 3, val: op.char_at(0).map(|c| c.code()) else 0, name: ""))
        else
            break
    true

fn Parser.term(mut self) bool
    if not self.unary()
        return false
    while true
        op := self.peek_op()
        if op == "*" or op == "/" or op == "%"
            self.pos += 1
            if not self.unary()
                return false
            self.out.push(Item(kind: 3, val: op.char_at(0).map(|c| c.code()) else 0, name: ""))
        else
            break
    true

fn Parser.unary(mut self) bool
    if self.peek_op() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.unary()
            return false
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 4, val: 0, name: ""))
        return true
    self.atom()

fn Parser.atom(mut self) bool
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return false
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 1
        self.pos += 1
        v := t.text.to_int()
        if v == none
            self.out.push(Item(kind: 5, val: 0, name: ""))
        else
            self.out.push(Item(kind: 0, val: v else 0, name: ""))
        return true
    if t.kind == 2
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return false
        self.pos += 1
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 2, val: 0, name: t.text))
        return true
    if t.text == "("
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.expr()
            return false
        if self.peek_op() != ")"
            return false
        self.pos += 1
        return true
    false

fn eval(items List[Item], env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    mut st := List[int]()
    for it in items
        if it.kind == 0
            st.push(it.val)
        elif it.kind == 5
            return "overflow"
        elif it.kind == 2
            st.push(env[it.name])
        elif it.kind == 4
            a := st.pop() else 0
            r := a.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
            st.push(r)
        else
            b := st.pop() else 0
            a := st.pop() else 0
            op := it.val
            if op == 43
                st.push(a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow")
            elif op == 45
                st.push(a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow")
            elif op == 42
                st.push(a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow")
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if op == 47
                    st.push(a.checked_div(b) else return "overflow")
                else
                    st.push(a.checked_rem(b) else return "overflow")
    st[0]

# returns error message or ""
fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) str
    toks := tokenize(line) else return "syntax"
    if toks.len() == 0
        return "syntax"
    first := toks[0]
    if first.kind != 2
        return "syntax"
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: 1, out: [])
    mut target := ""
    if first.text == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3 or toks[1].kind != 2 or toks[2].text != "=" or toks[2].kind != 3
            return "syntax"
        nm := toks[1].text
        if nm == "let" or nm == "print"
            return "syntax"
        target = nm
        p.pos = 3
    elif first.text == "print"
        p.pos = 1
    else
        return "syntax"
    if not p.expr()
        return "syntax"
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for it in p.out
        if it.kind == 2 and not env.contains(it.name)
            return "unknown {it.name}"
    v := eval(p.out, env) else err
        return err
    if first.text == "let"
        env[target] = v
    else
        print(v)
    ""

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut n := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        n += 1
        if line.chars().all(|c| c == ' ') or line.trim_start().starts_with("#")
            continue
        msg := run_line(line, mut vars)
        if msg != ""
            io.eprint("error: line {n}: {msg}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

struct Op
    kind char
    text str

struct P
    toks List[str]
    pos int
    out List[Op]

fn is_name_start(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_name_char(c char) bool
    is_name_start(c) or c.is_digit() or c == '_'

fn tokenize(line str) List[str] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c.is_digit()
            mut j := i
            while j < n and cs[j].is_digit()
                j += 1
            out.push(cs.slice(i, j).join(""))
            i = j
        elif is_name_start(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and is_name_char(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push(cs.slice(i, j).join(""))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')'
            out.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn kind_of(t str) char
    c := t.char_at(0) else ' '
    if c.is_digit()
        'n'
    elif is_name_start(c)
        if t == "let" or t == "print"
            'k'
        else
            'v'
    else
        'o'

fn P.peek(self) str
    if pos < toks.len()
        toks[pos]
    else
        ""

fn parse_atom(mut p P) ! str
    t := p.peek()
    if t == ""
        return "syntax"
    k := kind_of(t)
    if k == 'n'
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 'n', text: t))
        p.pos += 1
    elif k == 'v'
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 'v', text: t))
        p.pos += 1
    elif t == "("
        p.pos += 1
        parse_expr(mut p)?
        if p.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        p.pos += 1
    else
        return "syntax"

fn parse_unary(mut p P) ! str
    if p.peek() == "-"
        p.pos += 1
        parse_unary(mut p)?
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 'm', text: ""))
    else
        parse_atom(mut p)?

fn parse_term(mut p P) ! str
    parse_unary(mut p)?
    while p.peek() == "*" or p.peek() == "/" or p.peek() == "%"
        op := p.peek()
        p.pos += 1
        parse_unary(mut p)?
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 'o', text: op))

fn parse_expr(mut p P) ! str
    parse_term(mut p)?
    while p.peek() == "+" or p.peek() == "-"
        op := p.peek()
        p.pos += 1
        parse_term(mut p)?
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 'o', text: op))

fn apply(op str, a int, b int) int ! str
    if op == "+"
        a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
    elif op == "-"
        a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
    elif op == "*"
        a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
    elif b == 0
        return "division by zero"
    elif op == "/"
        a.checked_div(b) else return "overflow"
    else
        a.checked_rem(b) else return "overflow"

fn eval(ops List[Op], env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    for o in ops
        if o.kind == 'v' and not env.contains(o.text)
            return "unknown {o.text}"
    mut st := List[int]()
    for o in ops
        if o.kind == 'n'
            v := o.text.to_int() else return "overflow"
            st.push(v)
        elif o.kind == 'v'
            st.push(env[o.text])
        elif o.kind == 'm'
            a := st.pop() else return "syntax"
            st.push(a.checked_neg() else return "overflow")
        else
            b := st.pop() else return "syntax"
            a := st.pop() else return "syntax"
            st.push(apply(o.text, a, b)?)
    st[0]

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! str
    if line.trim_start().starts_with("#")
        return
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.is_empty()
        return
    mut p := P(toks: toks, pos: 0, out: [])
    mut name := ""
    if toks[0] == "print"
        p.pos = 1
    elif toks[0] == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3 or kind_of(toks[1]) != 'v' or toks[2] != "="
            return "syntax"
        name = toks[1]
        p.pos = 3
    else
        return "syntax"
    parse_expr(mut p)?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    v := eval(p.out, env)?
    if name == ""
        print(v)
    else
        env[name] = v

fn main() !
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in io.read_all().split("\n")
        k += 1
        run_line(line, mut vars) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

enum Expr
    Num(text str)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

struct Parser
    toks List[str]
    pos int

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if pos < toks.len()
        toks[pos]
    else
        ""

fn Parser.primary(mut self) Expr ! str
    t := self.peek()
    if t == ""
        return "syntax"
    c := t.char_at(0) else return "syntax"
    self.pos += 1
    if c.is_digit()
        return Num(text: t)
    if c.is_lower()
        if t == "let" or t == "print"
            return "syntax"
        return Var(name: t)
    if t == "-"
        e := self.primary()?
        return Neg(e: e)
    if t == "("
        e := self.sum()?
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return e
    "syntax"

fn Parser.term(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.primary()?
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.primary()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.sum(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.term()?
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn tokenize(line str) List[str] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c.is_digit()
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and cs[j].is_digit()
                j += 1
            out.push(cs[i..j].join(""))
            i = j
        elif c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or cs[j].is_digit() or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(cs[i..j].join(""))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn is_name(t str) bool
    c := t.char_at(0) else return false
    c.is_lower() and t != "let" and t != "print"

fn parse_expr(toks List[str], start int) Expr ! str
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: start)
    e := p.sum()?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    e

fn first_unknown(toks List[str], start int, env Map[str, int]) str?
    for i in start..toks.len()
        t := toks[i]
        if is_name(t) and not env.contains(t)
            return t
    none

    text str

struct P
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    check bool
    env Map[str, int]

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_dig(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok]?
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_dig(c)
            mut j := i
            mut parts := List[str]()
            while j < n and is_dig(cs[j])
                parts.push("{cs[j]}")
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: parts.join("")))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            mut parts := List[str]()
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_dig(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                parts.push("{cs[j]}")
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: parts.join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    out

fn P.at_op(self, s str) bool
    pos < toks.len() and toks[pos].kind == 2 and toks[pos].text == s

fn P.expr(mut self) int ! str
    mut v := self.term()?
    while self.at_op("+") or self.at_op("-")
        plus := self.at_op("+")
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        if not self.check
            if plus
                v = v.checked_add(r) else return "overflow"
            else
                v = v.checked_sub(r) else return "overflow"
    v

fn P.term(mut self) int ! str
    mut v := self.unary()?
    while self.at_op("*") or self.at_op("/") or self.at_op("%")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.unary()?
        if not self.check
            if op == "*"
                v = v.checked_mul(r) else return "overflow"
            else
                if r == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if op == "/"
                    v = v.checked_div(r) else return "overflow"
                else
                    v = v.checked_rem(r) else return "overflow"
    v

fn P.unary(mut self) int ! str
    if self.at_op("-")
        self.pos += 1
        v := self.unary()?
        if self.check
            return 0
        return v.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
    self.atom()?

fn P.atom(mut self) int ! str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 0
        self.pos += 1
        if self.check
            return 0
        return t.text.to_int() else return "overflow"
    if t.kind == 1
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        if self.check
            return 0
        return self.env.get(t.text) else return "unknown {t.text}"
    if t.text == "("
        self.pos += 1
        v := self.expr()?
        if not self.at_op(")")
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return v
    "syntax"

# returns error text or "" ; sets value via out
fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) str?
    toks := tokenize(line) else return "syntax"
    if toks.len() == 0
        return "syntax"
    mut start := 1
    mut name := ""
    first := toks[0]
    if first.kind != 1
        return "syntax"
    if first.text == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3 or toks[1].kind != 1 or toks[2].kind != 2 or toks[2].text != "="
            return "syntax"
        if toks[1].text == "let" or toks[1].text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        name = toks[1].text
        start = 3
    elif first.text != "print"
        return "syntax"
    mut p := P(toks: toks, pos: start, check: true, env: env)
    _ := p.expr() else e
        return e
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for i in start..toks.len()
        if toks[i].kind == 1 and not env.contains(toks[i].text)
            return "unknown {toks[i].text}"
    p.pos = start
    p.check = false
    v := p.expr() else e
        return e
    if name == ""
        print(v)
    else
        env[name] = v
    none

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut env := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        if line.trim_start().starts_with("#") or line.trim() == ""
            continue
        if line.contains("\t") or line.contains("\r")
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: syntax")
            failed = true
            continue
        if e := run_line(line, mut env)
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {e}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)
