struct Tok
    kind str
    text str

struct Op
    kind int
    num int
    name str

struct P
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    out List[Op]

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    cs := line.chars()
    n := cs.len()
    mut i := 0
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c.is_digit()
            mut j := i
            while j < n and cs[j].is_digit()
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'
            mut j := i
            while j < n and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or cs[j].is_digit() or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            w := cs.slice(i, j).join("")
            k := if w == "let" or w == "print" then "kw" else "name"
            toks.push(Tok(kind: k, text: w))
            i = j
        elif c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '='
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    toks

fn P.is_op(self, s str) bool
    pos < toks.len() and toks[pos].kind == "op" and toks[pos].text == s

fn operand(mut p P) ! str
    if p.pos >= p.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := p.toks[p.pos]
    if t.kind == "num"
        p.pos += 1
        v := t.text.to_int() else -1
        if v < 0
            p.out.push(Op(kind: 0, num: 0, name: "ovf"))
        else
            p.out.push(Op(kind: 0, num: v, name: ""))
    elif t.kind == "name"
        p.pos += 1
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 1, num: 0, name: t.text))
    elif p.is_op("-")
        p.pos += 1
        operand(mut p)?
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 2, num: 0, name: ""))
    elif p.is_op("(")
        p.pos += 1
        expr(mut p)?
        if not p.is_op(")")
            return "syntax"
        p.pos += 1
    else
        return "syntax"

fn term(mut p P) ! str
    operand(mut p)?
    while p.is_op("*") or p.is_op("/") or p.is_op("%")
        t := p.toks[p.pos].text
        p.pos += 1
        operand(mut p)?
        k := if t == "*" then 5 elif t == "/" then 6 else 7
        p.out.push(Op(kind: k, num: 0, name: ""))

fn expr(mut p P) ! str
    term(mut p)?
    while p.is_op("+") or p.is_op("-")
        t := p.toks[p.pos].text
        p.pos += 1
        term(mut p)?
        k := if t == "+" then 3 else 4
        p.out.push(Op(kind: k, num: 0, name: ""))

fn eval(ops List[Op], env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    for o in ops
        if o.kind == 1 and not env.contains(o.name)
            return "unknown {o.name}"
    mut st := List[int]()
    for o in ops
        if o.kind == 0
            if o.name == "ovf"
                return "overflow"
            st.push(o.num)
        elif o.kind == 1
            st.push(env[o.name])
        elif o.kind == 2
            a := st.pop() else 0
            r := a.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
            st.push(r)
        else
            b := st.pop() else 0
            a := st.pop() else 0
            if o.kind == 3
                st.push(a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow")
            elif o.kind == 4
                st.push(a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow")
            elif o.kind == 5
                st.push(a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow")
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if o.kind == 6
                    st.push(a.checked_div(b) else return "overflow")
                else
                    st.push(a.checked_rem(b) else return "overflow")
    st[0]

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! str
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return
    if toks[0].kind != "kw"
        return "syntax"
    mut p := P(toks: toks, pos: 1, out: [])
    mut target := ""
    if toks[0].text == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3 or toks[1].kind != "name" or toks[2].text != "=" or toks[2].kind != "op"
            return "syntax"
        target = toks[1].text
        p.pos = 3
    expr(mut p)?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    v := eval(p.out, env)?
    if toks[0].text == "let"
        env[target] = v
    else
        print(v)

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for raw in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        t := raw.trim_start_chars()
        if raw.chars().all(|c| c == ' ') or t.starts_with("#")
            continue
        run_line(raw, mut vars) else e
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {e}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

fn usage() never
    io.eprint("usage: depgraph order|cycles|deps NAME|rdeps NAME")
    io.exit(1)

fn valid(s str) bool
    if s.len() == 0
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        ok := (c >= 'a' and c <= 'z') or (c >= 'A' and c <= 'Z') or (c >= '0' and c <= '9') or c == '_' or c == '.' or c == '-'
        if not ok
            return false
    true

fn reach(adj List[List[int]], start int) List[int]
    mut seen := Set[int]()
    mut stack := [start]
    mut first := true
    mut out := []
    while stack.len() > 0
        cur := stack.pop() else 0
        for nx in adj[cur]
            if seen.add(nx)
                stack.push(nx)
                out.push(nx)
    out

fn main()
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() == 0
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    if cmd == "order" or cmd == "cycles"
        if args.len() != 1
            usage()
    elif cmd == "deps" or cmd == "rdeps"
        if args.len() != 2
            usage()
        if not valid(args[1])
            usage()
    else
        usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    mut bad := false
    mut names := Set[str]()
    mut edges := Set[str]()
    mut pairs := []
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        if line.len() == 0 or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        if line.contains(" -> ")
            parts := line.split(" -> ")
            if parts.len() == 2 and valid(parts[0]) and valid(parts[1])
                names.add(parts[0])
                names.add(parts[1])
                if edges.add("{parts[0]} -> {parts[1]}")
                    pairs.push([parts[0], parts[1]])
                continue
        elif valid(line)
            names.add(line)
            continue
        bad = true
        io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad line")
    sorted := names.sorted()
    n := sorted.len()
    mut id := Map[str, int]()
    for i, nm in sorted.enumerate()
        id[nm] = i
    mut adj := [[] for i in 0..n]
    mut radj := [[] for i in 0..n]
    for p in pairs
        a := id[p[0]]
        b := id[p[1]]
        adj[a].push(b)
        radj[b].push(a)
    mut code := 0
    if bad
        code = 2
    if cmd == "order"
        mut indeg := [adj[i].len() for i in 0..n]
        mut done := [false for i in 0..n]
        mut res := []
        for step in 0..n
            mut pick := -1
            for i in 0..n
                if not done[i] and indeg[i] == 0
                    pick = i
                    break
            if pick < 0
                io.eprint("error: cycle")
                io.exit(3)
            done[pick] = true
            res.push(sorted[pick])
            for r in radj[pick]
                indeg[r] -= 1
        for s in res
            print(s)
    elif cmd == "cycles"
        for i in 0..n
            if reach(adj, i).contains(i)
                print(sorted[i])
    else
        name := args[1]
        start := id.get(name) else -1
        if start < 0
            io.eprint("error: unknown {name}")
            io.exit(4)
        g := if cmd == "deps" then adj else radj
        mut r := reach(g, start).sorted()
        for x in r
            print(sorted[x])
    if code != 0
        io.exit(code)

fn usage() never
    io.eprint("usage: invjson json [TITLE]|tags")
    io.exit(1)

fn all_in(s str, ok fn(char) bool) bool
    if s.len() == 0
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if not ok(c)
            return false
    true

fn sku_ch(c char) bool
    (c >= 'A' and c <= 'Z') or (c >= '0' and c <= '9') or c == '-'

fn digit_ch(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn tag_ch(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn esc(s str) str
    mut out := []
    for c in s.chars()
        n := c.code()
        if c == '"'
            out.push("\\\"")
        elif c == '\\'
            out.push("\\\\")
        elif n == 9
            out.push("\\t")
        elif n == 10
            out.push("\\n")
        elif n < 32
            h := n.to_hex()
            out.push("\\u00{if h.len() < 2 then "0{h}" else h}")
        else
            out.push("{c}")
    out.join("")

fn main() !
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() == 0
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    if cmd == "json"
        if args.len() > 2
            usage()
    elif cmd == "tags"
        if args.len() != 1
            usage()
    else
        usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    mut qty := Map[str, int]()
    mut tags := Map[str, List[str]]()
    mut bad := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        if line.len() == 0 or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        parts := line.split(" ")
        mut ok := parts.len() >= 2 and all_in(parts[0], sku_ch) and all_in(parts[1], digit_ch) and parts[1].len() <= 7
        if ok
            for i in 2..parts.len()
                if not all_in(parts[i], tag_ch)
                    ok = false
        if not ok
            bad = true
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad line")
            continue
        sku := parts[0]
        q := parts[1].to_int() else 0
        if not qty.contains(sku)
            qty[sku] = 0
            tags[sku] = List[str]()
        qty[sku] += q
        mut tl := tags[sku]
        for i in 2..parts.len()
            if not tl.contains(parts[i])
                tl.push(parts[i])
        tags[sku] = tl
    if cmd == "json"
        mut total := 0
        for s in qty.keys()
            total += qty[s]
        print("\{")
        if args.len() == 2
            print("  \"title\": \"{esc(args[1])}\",")
        skus := qty.keys().sorted()
        if skus.len() == 0
            print("  \"items\": [],")
        else
            print("  \"items\": [")
            for i, s in skus.enumerate()
                tq := ", ".join([ "\"{t}\"" for t in tags[s] ])
                comma := if i + 1 < skus.len() then "," else ""
                print("    \{\"sku\": \"{s}\", \"qty\": {qty[s]}, \"tags\": [{tq}]}{comma}")
            print("  ],")
        print("  \"total\": {total}")
        print("}")
    else
        mut tot := Map[str, int]()
        for s in qty.keys()
            for t in tags[s]
                tot[t] += qty[s]
        names := tot.keys().sorted()
        res := names.sorted(by: |t| -tot[t])
        for t in res
            print("{t}\t{tot[t]}")
    if bad
        io.exit(2)

    date str
    account str
    amount int
    memo str

fn usage() never
    io.eprint("usage: ledger balance|top N|monthly")
    io.exit(1)

fn money(b bigint.BigInt) str
    s := "{b}"
    neg := s.starts_with("-")
    digits := if neg then s.slice(1) else s
    p := digits.pad_left(3, '0')
    n := p.len()
    body := "{p.slice(0, n - 2)}.{p.slice(n - 2)}"
    if neg then "-{body}" else body

fn all_digits(s str) bool
    if s.is_empty()
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if not c.is_digit()
            return false
    true

fn check_date(d str) bool
    if d.len() != 10
        return false
    if d.slice(4, 5) != "-" or d.slice(7, 8) != "-"
        return false
    y := d.slice(0, 4)
    m := d.slice(5, 7)
    dd := d.slice(8, 10)
    if not all_digits(y) or not all_digits(m) or not all_digits(dd)
        return false
    mi := m.to_int() else 0
    di := dd.to_int() else 0
    mi >= 1 and mi <= 12 and di >= 1 and di <= 31

fn parse_line(line str) Tx ! str
    f := line.split(",")
    if f.len() != 4
        return "wrong field count"
    if not check_date(f[0])
        return "bad date"
    if f[1].is_empty()
        return "empty account"
    a := f[2]
    body := if a.starts_with("-") then a.slice(1) else a
    if not all_digits(body)
        return "bad amount"
    n := a.to_int() else return "bad amount"
    Tx(date: f[0], account: f[1], amount: n, memo: f[3])

fn main() !
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() < 1
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    mut topn := 0

        if args.len() != 2
            usage()
        topn = args[1].to_int() else usage()
        if topn < 0

    if a == -9223372036854775807 - 1

struct Row
    date str
    account str
    amount int
    memo str

error enum LineError
    Fields "expected 4 fields"
    Date "bad date"
    Account "empty account"
    Amount "bad amount"

fn money(c bigint.BigInt) str
    zero := bigint.from_int(0)
    neg := c < zero
    a := if neg then -c else c
    q := a / bigint.from_int(100)
    r := a % bigint.from_int(100)
    sign := if neg then "-" else ""
    "{sign}{q}.{"{r}".pad_left(2, '0')}"

fn all_digits(s str) bool
    if s.is_empty()
        return false
    for ch in s.chars()
        if ch.code() < 48 or ch.code() > 57
            return false
    true

fn valid_date(d str) bool
    parts := d.split("-")
    if parts.len() != 3
        return false
    if parts[0].len() != 4 or parts[1].len() != 2 or parts[2].len() != 2
        return false
    if not (all_digits(parts[0]) and all_digits(parts[1]) and all_digits(parts[2]))
        return false
    month := parts[1].to_int() else 0
    day := parts[2].to_int() else 0
    month >= 1 and month <= 12 and day >= 1 and day <= 31

fn parse_amount(s str) int?
    digits := if s.starts_with("-") then s.slice(1, s.len()) else s
    if not all_digits(digits)
        return none
    s.to_int()

fn parse_row(line str) Row ! LineError
    f := line.split(",")
    if f.len() != 4
        return Fields
    if not valid_date(f[0])
        return Date
    if f[1].is_empty()
        return Account
    amount := parse_amount(f[2]) else return Amount
    Row(date: f[0], account: f[1], amount: amount, memo: f[3])

fn valid_args(args List[str]) bool
    if args.len() == 1
        return args[0] == "balance" or args[0] == "monthly"
    args.len() == 2 and args[0] == "top" and all_digits(args[1])

fn main()
    args := env.args()
    if not valid_args(args)
        io.eprint("usage: ledger balance|top N|monthly")
        io.exit(1)
    mut lines := io.read_all().split("\n")
    if (lines.last() else "x") == ""
        lines.pop()
    if lines.is_empty() or lines[0] != "date,account,amount_cents,memo"
        io.eprint("error: line 1: bad header")
        io.exit(2)
    mut rows := []
    mut bad := 0
    for k in 1..lines.len()
        row := parse_row(lines[k]) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k + 1}: {err}")
            bad += 1
            continue
        rows.push(row)
    cmd := args[0]
    if cmd == "top"
        n := args[1].to_int() else 1000000000000
        for r in rows.sorted(by: |r| (if r.amount < 0 then r.amount + 1 else 1 - r.amount)).take(n)
            print("{r.date}\t{r.account}\t{money(bigint.from_int(r.amount))}\t{r.memo}")
    else
        mut tot := {}
        for r in rows
            key := if cmd == "balance" then r.account else r.date.slice(0, 7)
            tot[key] = (tot.get(key) else bigint.from_int(0)) + bigint.from_int(r.amount)
        for key in tot.keys().sorted()
            print("{key}\t{money(tot[key])}")
    if bad > 0
        io.exit(2)

fn usage() never
    io.eprint("usage: maze path|draw|reach N")
    io.exit(1)

fn bad() never
    io.eprint("error: bad grid")
    io.exit(2)

fn bfs(open List[bool], w int, h int, src int) List[int]
    mut dist := [-1 for _ in 0..w * h]
    mut q := [src]
    dist[src] = 0
    mut head := 0
    while head < q.len()
        c := q[head]
        head += 1
        x := c % w
        y := c / w
        d := dist[c] + 1
        if y > 0 and open[c - w] and dist[c - w] < 0
            dist[c - w] = d
            q.push(c - w)
        if x > 0 and open[c - 1] and dist[c - 1] < 0
            dist[c - 1] = d
            q.push(c - 1)
        if x < w - 1 and open[c + 1] and dist[c + 1] < 0
            dist[c + 1] = d
            q.push(c + 1)
        if y < h - 1 and open[c + w] and dist[c + w] < 0
            dist[c + w] = d
            q.push(c + w)
    dist

fn main()
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() == 0
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    mut limit := 0
    if cmd == "path" or cmd == "draw"
        if args.len() != 1
            usage()
    elif cmd == "reach"
        if args.len() != 2
            usage()
        a := args[1]
        if a.len() < 1 or a.len() > 7
            usage()
        for ch in a.chars()
            if not ch.is_digit() or ch.code() > 57
                usage()
        limit = a.to_int() else usage()
    else
        usage()
    b := io.read_bytes()
    n := b.len()
    mut end := n
    if end > 0 and b[end - 1] == 10
        end -= 1
    if end == 0
        bad()
    mut open := List[bool]()
    mut wall := List[bool]()
    mut w := -1
    mut h := 0
    mut cur := 0
    mut s := -1
    mut e := -1
    mut i := 0
    while i <= end
        ch := if i < end then int(b[i]) else 10
        i += 1
        if ch == 10
            if w < 0
                w = cur
            if cur != w or cur == 0 or h >= 300
                bad()
            h += 1
            cur = 0
            continue
        if cur >= 300
            bad()
        idx := open.len()
        if ch == 46
            open.push(true)
        elif ch == 35
            open.push(false)
        elif ch == 83
            if s >= 0
                bad()
            s = idx
            open.push(true)
        elif ch == 69
            if e >= 0
                bad()
            e = idx
            open.push(true)
        else
            bad()
        wall.push(ch == 35)
        cur += 1
    if s < 0 or e < 0
        bad()
    if cmd == "reach"
        ds := bfs(open, w, h, s)
        mut cnt := 0
        for d in ds
            if d >= 0 and d <= limit
                cnt += 1
        print(cnt)
        return
    de := bfs(open, w, h, e)
    if de[s] < 0
        io.eprint("error: no path")
        io.exit(3)
    if cmd == "path"
        print(de[s])
        return
    mut mark := [false for _ in 0..w * h]
    mut c := s
    while c != e
        d := de[c] - 1
        x := c % w
        y := c / w

fn usage() never
    io.eprint("usage: stock report|low N|total")
    io.exit(1)

fn digits(s str, lo int) bool
    n := s.len()
    if n < 1 or n > 5
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if c < '0' or c > '9'
            return false
    true

fn skuok(s str) bool
    if s.len() < 1
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        ok := (c >= 'A' and c <= 'Z') or (c >= '0' and c <= '9') or c == '-'
        if not ok
            return false
    true

fn money(c int) str
    neg := c < 0
    a := if neg then 0 - c else c
    r := a % 100
    s := "{a / 100}.{r:02}"
    if neg
        return "-{s}"
    s

fn main()
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() < 1 or args.len() > 2
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    mut lim := 0
    if cmd == "report" or cmd == "total"
        if args.len() != 1
            usage()
    elif cmd == "low"
        if args.len() != 2 or not digits(args[1], 0)
            usage()
        lim = args[1].to_int() else 0
    else
        usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    mut lines := text.split("\n")
    if text.ends_with("\n")
        lines.pop()
    mut qty := Map[str, int]()
    mut cost := Map[str, int]()
    mut bad := false
    for i, line in lines.enumerate()
        k := i + 1
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        f := line.split(" ")
        mut ok := false
        mut kind := ""
        if f.len() >= 3 and skuok(f[1]) and digits(f[2], 0)
            kind = f[0]
            if kind == "receive" and f.len() == 4 and digits(f[3], 0)
                ok = f[2].to_int() else 0 > 0
            elif kind == "ship" and f.len() == 3
                ok = f[2].to_int() else 0 > 0
            elif kind == "count" and f.len() == 3
                ok = true
        if not ok
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad line")
            bad = true
            continue
        sku := f[1]
        n := f[2].to_int() else 0
        if kind == "receive"
            p := f[3].to_int() else 0
            qty[sku] += n
            cost[sku] += n * p
        elif not qty.contains(sku)
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: unknown {sku}")
            bad = true
        elif kind == "ship"
            q := qty[sku]
            if n > q
                io.eprint("error: line {k}: short {sku}")
                bad = true
            else
                cost[sku] = cost[sku] - cost[sku] * n / q
                qty[sku] = q - n
        else
            q := qty[sku]
            if q > 0
                cost[sku] = cost[sku] * n / q
            qty[sku] = n
    mut tot := 0
    for sku in qty.keys().sorted()
        if cmd == "report"
            print("{sku}\t{qty[sku]}\t{money(cost[sku])}")
        elif cmd == "low"
            if qty[sku] < lim
                print(sku)
        tot += cost[sku]
    if cmd == "total"
        print(money(tot))
    if bad
        io.exit(2)

    for c in s.chars()
        ok := (c >= 'A' and c <= 'Z') or (c >= '0' and c <= '9') or c == '-'
        if not ok
            return false

fn scale(cost int, q int, d int) int
    r := bigint.from_int(cost) * bigint.from_int(q) / bigint.from_int(d)

fn money(c int) str
    neg := c < 0
    a := if neg then -c else c
    d := a / 100
    r := a % 100
    "{if neg then "-" else ""}{d}.{r.pad_left(2, '0')}"

                io.eprint("error: line {n}: unknown {sku}")

fn usage() never
    io.eprint("usage: stock report|low N|total")
    io.exit(1)

fn money(c int) str
    neg := c < 0
    a := if neg then 0 - c else c
    r := a % 100
    s := "{a / 100}.{r.to_str_pad()}"
    if neg then "-{s}" else s

fn int.to_str_pad(self) str
    "{self}".pad_left(2, '0')

fn all_digits(s str, lo int, hi int) bool
    if s.len() < lo or s.len() > hi
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if not c.is_digit()
            return false
    true

fn valid_sku(s str) bool
    if s.len() == 0
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if not (c.is_digit() or c == '-' or (c.is_upper() and c.code() < 128))
            return false
    true

fn main()
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() == 0
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    mut limit := 0
    if cmd == "report" or cmd == "total"
        if args.len() != 1
            usage()
    elif cmd == "low"
        if args.len() != 2
            usage()
        if not all_digits(args[1], 1, 5)
            usage()
        limit = args[1].to_int() else 0
    else
        usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    mut parts := text.split("\n")
    if text.ends_with("\n")
        parts.pop()
    mut qty := Map[str, int]()
    mut cost := Map[str, int]()
    mut bad := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in parts
        k += 1
        if line.is_empty() or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        f := line.split(" ")
        kind := f[0]
        ok := if kind == "receive" then f.len() == 4 elif kind == "ship" or kind == "count" then f.len() == 3 else false
        if not ok or not valid_sku(f[1])
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad line")
            bad = true
            continue
        sku := f[1]
        minq := if kind == "count" then 0 else 1
        if not all_digits(f[2], 1, 5) or (f[2].to_int() else 0) < minq
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad line")
            bad = true
            continue
        n := f[2].to_int() else 0
        if kind == "receive"
            if not all_digits(f[3], 1, 5)
                io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad line")
                bad = true
                continue
            p := f[3].to_int() else 0
            qty[sku] = (qty.get(sku) else 0) + n
            cost[sku] = (cost.get(sku) else 0) + n * p
            continue
        if not qty.contains(sku)
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: unknown {sku}")
            bad = true
            continue
        q := qty[sku]
        c := cost[sku]
        if kind == "ship"
            if n > q
                io.eprint("error: line {k}: short {sku}")
                bad = true
                continue
            cost[sku] = c - ((c / q) * n + ((c % q) * n) / q)
            qty[sku] = q - n
        else
            if q > 0
                cost[sku] = (c / q) * n + ((c % q) * n) / q
            qty[sku] = n
    skus := qty.keys().sorted()
    if cmd == "report"
        for s in skus
            print("{s}\t{qty[s]}\t{money(cost[s])}")
    elif cmd == "low"
        for s in skus
            if qty[s] < limit
                print(s)
    else
        mut t := 0
        for s in skus
            t += cost[s]
        print(money(t))
    if bad
        io.exit(2)

    elif args[0] == "total"
        out = render.total(stock)

## till: a shop's back office. Reads the journal on stdin and prints one report (spec.md).
use cli
use journal
use reports
use shop

## Prints `error: no WHAT` and ends the program with exit code 3.
fn missing(what str)
    io.eprint("error: no {what}")
    io.exit(3)

fn main()
    cmd := cli.parse(env.args())
    if cmd == cli.Command.Usage
        io.eprint(cli.usage())
        io.exit(1)
    mut lines := io.read_all().split("\n")
    if (lines.last() else "x") == ""
        lines.pop()
    mut s := shop.Shop.new()
    mut bad := 0
    for k in 0..lines.len()
        line := lines[k]
        if line.is_empty() or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        e := journal.parse(line) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k + 1}: {err}")
            bad += 1
            continue
        s.apply(e) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k + 1}: {err}")
            bad += 1
    mut out := List[str]()
    match cmd
        ShowOrders => out = reports.order_lines(s)
        Invoice(id) =>
            out = reports.invoice(s, id) else List[str]()
            if not s.book.has(id)
                missing("order {id}")
        ShowStock => out = reports.stock_lines(s)
        Low(n) => out = reports.low(s, n)
        ShowCustomers => out = reports.customer_lines(s)
        History(cust) =>
            out = reports.history(s, cust) else List[str]()
            if not s.people.has(cust)
                missing("customer {cust}")
        Sales => out = reports.sales(s)
        Margin => out = reports.margin(s)
        Purchases => out = reports.purchase_lines(s)
        Gifts => out = reports.gift_lines(s)
        ShowPromos => out = reports.promo_lines(s)
        Usage => return
    for l in out
        print(l)
    if bad > 0
        io.exit(2)

    Num(text str)
    Id(name str)
    Op(c str)
    LP
    RP
    Eq

enum Expr
    Lit(text str)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn lex(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push(Num(text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(Id(name: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif c == '('
            out.push(LP)
            i += 1
        elif c == ')'
            out.push(RP)
            i += 1
        elif c == '='
            out.push(Eq)
            i += 1
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%'
            out.push(Op(c: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn Parser.peek_op(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        match self.toks[self.pos]
            Op(c) => return c
            _ => return ""
    ""

fn Parser.atom(mut self) Expr ! str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    self.pos += 1
    match t
        Num(text) => Lit(text: text)
        Id(name) =>
            if name == "let" or name == "print"
                return "syntax"
            Var(name: name)
        LP =>
            e := self.expr()?
            if self.pos < self.toks.len()
                match self.toks[self.pos]
                    RP =>
                        self.pos += 1
                        return e
                    _ => return "syntax"
            return "syntax"
        _ => return "syntax"

fn Parser.unary(mut self) Expr ! str
    if self.peek_op() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.unary()?
        return Neg(e: e)
    self.atom()

fn Parser.term(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.unary()?
    while self.peek_op() == "*" or self.peek_op() == "/" or self.peek_op() == "%"
        op := self.peek_op()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.unary()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.expr(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.term()?
    while self.peek_op() == "+" or self.peek_op() == "-"
        op := self.peek_op()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn find_unknown(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) str?
    match e
        Lit(t) => none
        Var(n) =>
            if env.contains(n)
                return none
            n
        Neg(x) => find_unknown(x, env)
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := find_unknown(l, env)
            if a != none
                return a
            find_unknown(r, env)

fn eval(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    match e
        Lit(t) => t.to_int() else return "overflow"
        Var(n) => env[n]
        Neg(x) =>
            v := eval(x, env)?
            v.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                return a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
            if op == "-"
                return a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
            if op == "*"
                return a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
            if b == 0
                return "division by zero"
            if op == "/"
                return a.checked_div(b) else return "overflow"
            a.checked_rem(b) else return "overflow"

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! str
    toks := lex(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return "syntax"
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: 0)
    mut target := ""
    match toks[0]
        Id(name) =>
            if name == "let"
                if toks.len() < 3
                    return "syntax"
                match toks[1]
                    Id(n) =>
                        if n == "let" or n == "print"
                            return "syntax"
                        target = n
                    _ => return "syntax"
                match toks[2]
                    Eq => p.pos = 3
                    _ => return "syntax"
            elif name == "print"
                p.pos = 1
            else

    else

    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")

            continue

            continue

            continue

            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

struct Tok
    kind str
    text str

    Num(v int, ok bool)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int

fn min_int() int
    -9223372036854775807 - 1

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! Bad
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c.is_digit()
            mut j := i
            while j < n and cs[j].is_digit()
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or cs[j].is_digit() or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "name", text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: line.slice(i, i + 1)))
            i += 1
        else
            return Bad(msg: "syntax")
    out

fn Parser.peek(self) Tok?
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        return self.toks[self.pos]
    none

fn Parser.at_op(self, s str) bool
    t := self.peek() else return false
    t.kind == "op" and t.text == s

fn parse_primary(mut p Parser) Expr ! Bad
    t := p.peek() else return Bad(msg: "syntax")
    if t.kind == "num"
        p.pos += 1
        v := t.text.to_int()
        if v == none
            return Num(v: 0, ok: false)
        return Num(v: v else 0, ok: true)
    if t.kind == "name"
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return Bad(msg: "syntax")
        p.pos += 1
        return Var(name: t.text)
    if t.kind == "op" and t.text == "("
        p.pos += 1
        e := parse_expr(mut p)?
        if not p.at_op(")")
            return Bad(msg: "syntax")
        p.pos += 1
        return e
    "syntax"

    if p.at_op("-")
        p.pos += 1
        e := parse_unary(mut p)?
        return Neg(e: e)
    parse_primary(mut p)

    mut l := parse_unary(mut p)?
    while p.at_op("*") or p.at_op("/") or p.at_op("%")
        op := p.toks[p.pos].text
        p.pos += 1
        r := parse_unary(mut p)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

    mut l := parse_term(mut p)?
    while p.at_op("+") or p.at_op("-")

            if v == min_int()

            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                return a.checked_add(b) else return Bad(msg: "overflow")

    pos int
    out List[Item]

    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut s := List[str]()
            while i < n and is_digit(cs[i])
                s.push("{cs[i]}")
                i += 1
            t := s.join("")
            v := t.to_int()
            if v == none
                toks.push(Tok(kind: 3, text: t, val: 0))
            else
                toks.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: t, val: v else 0))
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut s := List[str]()
            while i < n and (is_lower(cs[i]) or is_digit(cs[i]) or cs[i] == '_')
                s.push("{cs[i]}")
                i += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: s.join(""), val: 0))
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: "{c}", val: 0))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    toks

fn Parser.peek_op(self) str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return ""
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 2
        return t.text
    ""

fn is_reserved(s str) bool
    s == "let" or s == "print"

fn Parser.expr(mut self) ! str
    self.term()?
    while true
        op := self.peek_op()
        if op == "+" or op == "-"
            self.pos += 1
            self.term()?
            self.out.push(Item(kind: 4, text: op, val: 0))
        else
            break

fn Parser.term(mut self) ! str
    self.unary()?
    while true
        op := self.peek_op()
        if op == "*" or op == "/" or op == "%"
            self.pos += 1
            self.unary()?
            self.out.push(Item(kind: 4, text: op, val: 0))
        else
            break

fn Parser.unary(mut self) ! str
    if self.peek_op() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        self.unary()?
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 3, text: "", val: 0))
        return
    self.primary()?

fn Parser.primary(mut self) ! str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 0
        self.pos += 1
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 0, text: "", val: t.val))
    elif t.kind == 3
        self.pos += 1
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 1, text: "", val: 0))
    elif t.kind == 1
        if is_reserved(t.text)
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        self.out.push(Item(kind: 2, text: t.text, val: 0))
    elif t.text == "("

        self.pos += 1
    else
        return "syntax"

            r := 0.checked_sub(a) else return "overflow"
            st.push(r)
        else

            a := st.pop() else 0
            if it.text == "+"
                r := a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            elif it.text == "-"
                r := a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            elif it.text == "*"
                r := a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if b == -1
                    if a == minv
                        return "overflow"
                    if it.text == "%"
                        st.push(0)
                    else
                        st.push(0 - a)
                else
                    if it.text == "/"
                        st.push(a / b)
                    else
                        st.push(a % b)
    st.pop() else 0

# returns the printed text or "" for let/blank
fn run_line(line str, mut vars Map[str, int]) str ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut first := 0
    while first < cs.len() and cs[first] == ' '
        first += 1
    if first >= cs.len() or cs[first] == '#'
        return ""

    mut target := ""

        if toks[1].kind != 1 or is_reserved(toks[1].text)

        target = toks[1].text

    elif toks[0].kind == 1 and toks[0].text == "print"
        p.pos = 1
    else
        return "syntax"
    p.expr()?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for it in p.out
        if it.kind == 2 and not vars.contains(it.text)
            return "unknown {it.text}"
    v := eval(p.out, vars)?
    if is_let
        vars[target] = v
        return ""
    "{v}"

fn main() !
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)

enum Expr
    Num(text str)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

struct Parser
    toks List[str]
    pos int

fn is_digit(c str) bool
    "0123456789".contains(c)

fn is_lower(c str) bool
    "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(c)

fn is_name(t str) bool
    t.len() > 0 and is_lower(t.slice(0, 1))

fn is_num(t str) bool
    t.len() > 0 and is_digit(t.slice(0, 1))

fn tokenize(line str) List[str] ! str
    mut out := List[str]()
    cs := line.chars()
    n := cs.len()
    mut i := 0
    while i < n
        c := "{cs[i]}"
        if c == " "
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and is_digit("{cs[j]}")
                j += 1
            out.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and (is_lower("{cs[j]}") or is_digit("{cs[j]}") or "{cs[j]}" == "_")
                j += 1
            out.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif "+-*/%()=".contains(c)
            out.push(c)
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        self.toks[self.pos]
    else
        ""

fn Parser.primary(mut self) Expr ! str
    t := self.peek()
    if t == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.primary()?
        return Neg(e: e)
    if t == "("
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.expr()?
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return e
    if is_num(t)
        self.pos += 1
        return Num(text: t)
    if is_name(t) and t != "let" and t != "print"
        self.pos += 1
        return Var(name: t)
    return "syntax"

fn Parser.term(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.primary()?
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.primary()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.expr(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.term()?
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn eval(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    match e
        Num(text) =>
            v := text.to_int() else return "overflow"
            v
        Var(name) => env[name]
        Neg(x) =>
            v := eval(x, env)?
            lo := -9223372036854775807 - 1
            if v == lo
                return "overflow"
            -v
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            lo := -9223372036854775807 - 1
            if op == "+"
                return a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
            if op == "-"
                return a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
            if op == "*"
                return a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
            if b == 0
                return "division by zero"
            if a == lo and b == -1
                return "overflow"
            if op == "/"
                return a / b
            a % b

fn run_line(toks List[str], env Map[str, int]) int? ! str
    is_let := toks[0] == "let"
    start := if is_let then 3 else 1
    if is_let
        if toks.len() < 4 or not is_name(toks[1]) or toks[1] == "print" or toks[1] == "let" or toks[2] != "="
            return "syntax"
    elif toks[0] != "print"
        return "syntax"
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: start)
    e := p.expr()?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    mut i := start
    while i < toks.len()
        t := toks[i]
        if is_name(t) and not env.contains(t)
            return "unknown {t}"
        i += 1
    v := eval(e, env)?
    if is_let
        env[toks[1]] = v
        return none
    v

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        t := line.trim_start()
        if t == "" or t.starts_with("#")
            continue
        toks := tokenize(line) else err
            failed = true
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            continue
        r := run_line(toks, vars) else err
            failed = true
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            continue
        if r != none
            print(r else 0)
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

fn is_lower(c char) bool

fn tokenize(line str) List[str]?
    cs := line.chars()
    mut toks := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            toks.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            toks.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    toks

fn kind(t str) int
    # 0 number, 1 name, 2 keyword, 3 symbol
    c := t.char_at(0) else ' '
    if is_digit(c)
        return 0
    if is_lower(c)
        if t == "let" or t == "print"
            return 2
        return 1
    3

fn peek(p Parser) str
    if p.pos < p.toks.len()
        return p.toks[p.pos]
    ""

fn parse_atom(mut p Parser) bool
    t := peek(p)
    if t == ""
        return false
    if t == "-"
        p.pos += 1
        if not parse_atom(mut p)
            return false
        p.out.push("neg")
        return true
    if t == "("
        p.pos += 1
        if not parse_sum(mut p)
            return false
        if peek(p) != ")"
            return false
        p.pos += 1
        return true
    k := kind(t)
    if k == 0 or k == 1
        p.out.push(t)
        p.pos += 1
        return true
    false

fn parse_term(mut p Parser) bool
    if not parse_atom(mut p)
        return false
    while peek(p) == "*" or peek(p) == "/" or peek(p) == "%"
        op := peek(p)
        p.pos += 1
        if not parse_atom(mut p)
            return false
        p.out.push(op)
    true

fn parse_sum(mut p Parser) bool
    if not parse_term(mut p)
        return false
    while peek(p) == "+" or peek(p) == "-"
        op := peek(p)
        p.pos += 1
        if not parse_term(mut p)
            return false
        p.out.push(op)
    true

    mut st := List[int]()
    min := (-9223372036854775807) - 1
    for t in rpn
        if t == "neg"
            a := st.pop() else return "syntax"
            if a == min
                return "overflow"
            st.push(-a)
        elif t == "+" or t == "-" or t == "*" or t == "/" or t == "%"
            b := st.pop() else return "syntax"
            a := st.pop() else return "syntax"

            elif t == "-"
                r := a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            elif t == "*"
                r := a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if a == min and b == -1
                    return "overflow"
                if t == "/"
                    st.push(a / b)
                else
                    st.push(a % b)

            v := t.to_int() else return "overflow"
            st.push(v)

            st.push(v)

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int], mut printed List[str]) str
    toks := tokenize(line) else return "syntax"
    if toks.len() == 0
        return ""
    if toks[0].starts_with("#") 
        return ""
    mut start := 1
    mut target := ""
    is_let := toks[0] == "let"
    if is_let
        if toks.len() < 4
            return "syntax"
        if kind(toks[1]) != 1 or toks[2] != "="
            return "syntax"
        target = toks[1]

        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut lineno := 0
    pieces := text.split("\n")
    for raw in pieces
        lineno += 1
        mut printed := List[str]()
        msg := run_line(raw, mut vars, mut printed)
        for s in printed
            print(s)
        if msg != ""

enum Expr
    Num(text str)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

struct Parser
    toks List[str]
    pos int

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        self.toks[self.pos]
    else
        ""

fn Parser.primary(mut self) Expr ! str
    t := self.peek()
    if t == ""
        return "syntax"
    self.pos += 1
    if t == "("
        e := self.sum()?
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return e
    if t == "-"
        e := self.primary()?
        return Neg(e: e)
    c := t.slice(0, 1)
    if c == "n"
        return Num(text: t.slice(1, t.len()))
    if c == "i"
        return Var(name: t.slice(1, t.len()))
    return "syntax"

fn Parser.term(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.primary()?
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.primary()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.sum(mut self) Expr ! str
    mut l := self.term()?
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn tokenize(line str) List[str] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push("n{line.slice(i, j)}")
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            w := line.slice(i, j)
            if w == "let" or w == "print"
                out.push("k{w}")
            else
                out.push("i{w}")
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn names(e Expr, acc List[str]) List[str]
    mut out := acc
    match e
        Num(_) => out
        Var(n) =>
            out.push(n)
            out
        Neg(x) => names(x, out)
        Bin(_, l, r) => names(r, names(l, out))

const MIN := -9223372036854775807 - 1

fn eval(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    match e
        Num(t) =>
            n := t.to_int() else return "overflow"
            n
        Var(n) => env[n]
        Neg(x) =>
            a := eval(x, env)?
            if a == MIN
                return "overflow"

enum Tok
    Num(text str)
    Name(text str)
    Op(c str)

enum Expr
    Lit(text str)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

error enum CalcErr
    Overflow "overflow"
    DivZero "division by zero"

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    names List[str]

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn lex(cs List[char]) List[Tok]?
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut s := i
            while i < n and is_digit(cs[i])
                i += 1
            out.push(Num(text: cs[s..i].join("")))
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut s := i
            while i < n and (is_lower(cs[i]) or is_digit(cs[i]) or cs[i] == '_')
                i += 1
            out.push(Name(text: cs[s..i].join("")))
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Op(c: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    out

fn Parser.peek_op(self) str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return ""
    match self.toks[self.pos]
        Op(c) => c
        _ => ""

fn Parser.atom(mut self) Expr?
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return none
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    self.pos += 1
    match t
        Num(text) => Lit(text: text)
        Name(text) =>
            if text == "let" or text == "print"
                return none
            self.names.push(text)
            Var(name: text)
        Op(c) =>
            if c == "-"
                e := self.atom() else return none
                return Neg(e: e)
            if c == "("
                e := self.sum() else return none
                if self.peek_op() != ")"
                    return none
                self.pos += 1
                return e
            none

fn Parser.prod(mut self) Expr?
    mut l := self.atom() else return none
    while self.peek_op() == "*" or self.peek_op() == "/" or self.peek_op() == "%"
        op := self.peek_op()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.atom() else return none
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.sum(mut self) Expr?
    mut l := self.prod() else return none
    while self.peek_op() == "+" or self.peek_op() == "-"
        op := self.peek_op()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.prod() else return none
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn eval(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) int ! CalcErr
    match e
        Lit(text) => text.to_int() else return Overflow
        Var(name) => env[name]
        Neg(x) =>
            v := eval(x, env)?
            v.checked_sub(0) else return Overflow
            0.checked_sub(v) else return Overflow
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                a.checked_add(b) else return Overflow
            elif op == "-"
                a.checked_sub(b) else return Overflow
            elif op == "*"
                a.checked_mul(b) else return Overflow
            else
                if b == 0
                    return DivZero
                if op == "/"
                    a.checked_div(b) else return Overflow
                else
                    a.checked_rem(b) else return Overflow

fn fail(k int, msg str)
    io.eprint("error: line {k}: {msg}")

fn main() !
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut bad := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        cs := line.chars()
        mut first := 0
        while first < cs.len() and cs[first] == ' '
            first += 1
        if first < cs.len() and cs[first] == '#'
            continue
        toks := lex(cs) else
            fail(k, "syntax")
            bad = true
            continue
        if toks.len() == 0
            continue
        mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: 0, names: List[str]())
        mut target := ""
        mut ok := true

    Op(c str)

enum Expr
    Lit(text str)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

error enum CalcErr
    Overflow "overflow"
    DivZero "division by zero"

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    names List[str]

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn lex(cs List[char]) List[Tok]?
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut s := i
            while i < n and is_digit(cs[i])
                i += 1
            out.push(Num(text: cs[s..i].join("")))
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut s := i
            while i < n and (is_lower(cs[i]) or is_digit(cs[i]) or cs[i] == '_')
                i += 1
            out.push(Name(text: cs[s..i].join("")))
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Op(c: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    out

fn Parser.peek_op(self) str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return ""
    match self.toks[self.pos]
        Op(c) => c
        _ => ""

fn Parser.atom(mut self) Expr?
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return none
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    self.pos += 1
    match t
        Num(text) => Lit(text: text)
        Name(text) =>
            if text == "let" or text == "print"
                return none
            self.names.push(text)
            Var(name: text)
        Op(c) =>
            if c == "-"
                e := self.atom() else return none
                return Neg(e: e)
            if c == "("
                e := self.sum() else return none
                if self.peek_op() != ")"
                    return none
                self.pos += 1
                return e
            none

fn Parser.prod(mut self) Expr?
    mut l := self.atom() else return none
    while self.peek_op() == "*" or self.peek_op() == "/" or self.peek_op() == "%"
        op := self.peek_op()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.atom() else return none
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.sum(mut self) Expr?
    mut l := self.prod() else return none
    while self.peek_op() == "+" or self.peek_op() == "-"
        op := self.peek_op()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.prod() else return none
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)

            else

                if op == "/"

                else

    args := env.args()
    if args.len() > 0

error enum Fail
    Syntax "syntax"
    Unknown(name str) "unknown {name}"
    Overflow "overflow"
    DivZero "division by zero"

struct Tok
    kind str
    text str

enum Expr
    Num(text str)
    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! Fail
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                t = "{t}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: t))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                t = "{t}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "name", text: t))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return Syntax
    out

fn is_op(ts List[Tok], p int, s str) bool
    p < ts.len() and ts[p].kind == "op" and ts[p].text == s

fn parse_primary(ts List[Tok], mut p int) Expr ! Fail
    if p >= ts.len()
        return Syntax
    t := ts[p]
    if t.kind == "num"
        p += 1
        return Num(text: t.text)
    if t.kind == "name"
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return Syntax
        p += 1
        return Var(name: t.text)
    if is_op(ts, p, "-")
        p += 1
        e := parse_primary(ts, mut p)?
        return Neg(e: e)
    if is_op(ts, p, "(")
        p += 1
        e := parse_sum(ts, mut p)?
        if not is_op(ts, p, ")")
            return Syntax
        p += 1
        return e
    return Syntax

fn parse_term(ts List[Tok], mut p int) Expr ! Fail
    mut l := parse_primary(ts, mut p)?
    while is_op(ts, p, "*") or is_op(ts, p, "/") or is_op(ts, p, "%")
        op := ts[p].text
        p += 1
        r := parse_primary(ts, mut p)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn parse_sum(ts List[Tok], mut p int) Expr ! Fail
    mut l := parse_term(ts, mut p)?
    while is_op(ts, p, "+") or is_op(ts, p, "-")
        op := ts[p].text
        p += 1
        r := parse_term(ts, mut p)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn eval(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) int ! Fail
    match e
        Num(text) =>
            v := text.to_int() else return Overflow
            v
        Var(name) =>
            v := env.get(name) else return Unknown(name: name)
            v
        Neg(x) =>
            v := eval(x, env)?
            r := v.checked_neg() else return Overflow
            r
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                x := a.checked_add(b) else return Overflow
                return x
            if op == "-"
                x := a.checked_sub(b) else return Overflow
                return x
            if op == "*"
                x := a.checked_mul(b) else return Overflow
                return x
            if b == 0
                return DivZero
            if op == "/"
                x := a.checked_div(b) else return Overflow
                return x
            x := a.checked_rem(b) else return Overflow
            x

fn first_unknown(e Expr, env Map[str, int]) str?
    match e
        Num(text) => none
        Var(name) =>
            if env.contains(name)
                none
            else
                name
        Neg(x) => first_unknown(x, env)
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            u := first_unknown(l, env)
            if u != none
                u
            else
                first_unknown(r, env)

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! Fail
    ts := tokenize(line)?
    if ts.len() == 0
        return
    mut p := 0
    mut target := ""
    mut is_let := false
    if ts[0].kind == "name" and ts[0].text == "let"
        is_let = true
        if ts.len() < 3 or ts[1].kind != "name" or ts[1].text == "let" or ts[1].text == "print"
            return Syntax
        if not is_op(ts, 2, "=")
            return Syntax
        target = ts[1].text
        p = 3
    elif ts[0].kind == "name" and ts[0].text == "print"
        p = 1
    else
        return Syntax
    e := parse_sum(ts, mut p)?
    if p != ts.len()
        return Syntax
    if u := first_unknown(e, env)
        return Unknown(name: u)
    v := eval(e, env)?
    if is_let
        env[target] = v
    else
        print(v)

fn strip_spaces(s str) str
    cs := s.chars()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len() and cs[i] == ' '
        i += 1
    s.slice(i, cs.len())

fn main() !

    Num(text str)
    Name(text str)
    Op(c char)

struct Node
    kind int
    op char
    text str
    a int
    b int

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    nodes List[Node]

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    cs := line.chars()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c >= '0' and c <= '9'
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9'
                j += 1
            out.push(Num(text: cs[i..j].join("")))
            i = j
        elif c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or (cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9') or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(Name(text: cs[i..j].join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Op(c: c))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn Parser.peek_op(self) char?
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return none
    match self.toks[self.pos]
        Op(c) => c
        _ => none

fn Parser.add(mut self, n Node) int
    self.nodes.push(n)
    self.nodes.len() - 1

fn Parser.atom(mut self) int ! str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    self.pos += 1
    match t
        Num(text) => 
            return self.add(Node(kind: 0, op: ' ', text: text, a: 0, b: 0))
        Name(text) =>
            if text == "let" or text == "print"
                return "syntax"
            return self.add(Node(kind: 1, op: ' ', text: text, a: 0, b: 0))
        Op(c) =>
            if c == '-'
                x := self.atom()?
                return self.add(Node(kind: 2, op: ' ', text: "", a: x, b: 0))
            if c == '('
                x := self.expr()?
                if self.peek_op() != ')'
                    return "syntax"
                self.pos += 1
                return x
            return "syntax"

fn Parser.term(mut self) int ! str
    mut l := self.atom()?
    while true
        c := self.peek_op() else break
        if c != '*' and c != '/' and c != '%'
            break
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.atom()?
        l = self.add(Node(kind: 3, op: c, text: "", a: l, b: r))
    l

fn Parser.expr(mut self) int ! str
    mut l := self.term()?
    while true
        c := self.peek_op() else break
        if c != '+' and c != '-'
            break
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = self.add(Node(kind: 3, op: c, text: "", a: l, b: r))
    l

fn eval(nodes List[Node], i int, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    n := nodes[i]
    if n.kind == 0
        return n.text.to_int() else return "overflow"
    if n.kind == 1
        return env[n.text]
    if n.kind == 2
        x := eval(nodes, n.a, env)?
        return 0.checked_sub(x) else return "overflow"
    l := eval(nodes, n.a, env)?
    r := eval(nodes, n.b, env)?
    if n.op == '+'
        return l.checked_add(r) else return "overflow"
    if n.op == '-'
        return l.checked_sub(r) else return "overflow"
    if n.op == '*'
        return l.checked_mul(r) else return "overflow"
    if r == 0
        return "division by zero"
    if n.op == '/'
        return l.checked_div(r) else return "overflow"
    if r == -1
        return 0
    l % r

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! str
    t := line.trim()
    if t == "" or t.starts_with("#")
        return
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: 0, nodes: List[Node]())
    mut target := ""
    mut is_let := false
    first := match toks[0]
        Name(text) => text
        _ => ""
    if first == "let"
        is_let = true
        if toks.len() < 3
            return "syntax"
        match toks[1]
            Name(text) =>
                if text == "let" or text == "print"
                    return "syntax"
                target = text
            _ => return "syntax"
        if p.peek_op_at(2) != '='
            return "syntax"
        p.pos = 3
    elif first == "print"
        p.pos = 1
    else
        return "syntax"
    root := p.expr()?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for n in p.nodes
        if n.kind == 1 and not env.contains(n.text)
            return "unknown {n.text}"
    v := eval(p.nodes, root, env)?
    if is_let
        env[target] = v
        return
    print(v)

fn Parser.peek_op_at(self, k int) char?
    if k >= self.toks.len()
        return none
    match self.toks[k]
        Op(c) => c
        _ => none

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        run_line(line, mut vars) else e
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {e}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

struct Tok
    kind str
    text str

struct PState
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    out List[Tok]

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "n", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i + 1
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "i", text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif "+-*/%()=".contains(c)
            toks.push(Tok(kind: "o", text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    toks

fn PState.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        t := self.toks[self.pos]
        if t.kind == "o"
            return t.text
        return t.kind
    ""

fn parse_expr(mut st PState) ! str
    parse_term(mut st)?
    while st.peek() == "+" or st.peek() == "-"
        op := st.toks[st.pos]
        st.pos += 1
        parse_term(mut st)?
        st.out.push(op)

fn parse_term(mut st PState) ! str
    parse_unary(mut st)?
    while st.peek() == "*" or st.peek() == "/" or st.peek() == "%"
        op := st.toks[st.pos]
        st.pos += 1
        parse_unary(mut st)?
        st.out.push(op)

fn parse_unary(mut st PState) ! str
    p := st.peek()
    if p == "-"
        st.pos += 1
        parse_unary(mut st)?
        st.out.push(Tok(kind: "neg", text: "-"))
    elif p == "n"
        st.out.push(st.toks[st.pos])
        st.pos += 1
    elif p == "i"
        t := st.toks[st.pos]
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        st.out.push(t)
        st.pos += 1
    elif p == "("
        st.pos += 1
        parse_expr(mut st)?
        if st.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        st.pos += 1
    else
        return "syntax"

fn parse_all(toks List[Tok], start int) List[Tok] ! str
    mut st := PState(toks: toks, pos: start, out: List[Tok]())
    parse_expr(mut st)?
    if st.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    st.out

fn eval(rpn List[Tok], env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    mut stack := List[int]()
    for t in rpn
        if t.kind == "n"
            v := t.text.to_int() else return "overflow"
            stack.push(v)
        elif t.kind == "i"
            stack.push(env[t.text])
        elif t.kind == "neg"
            a := stack.pop() else return "syntax"
            r := a.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
            stack.push(r)
        else
            b := stack.pop() else return "syntax"
            a := stack.pop() else return "syntax"
            op := t.text
            if op == "+"
                stack.push(a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow")
            elif op == "-"
                stack.push(a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow")
            elif op == "*"
                stack.push(a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow")
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if op == "/"
                    stack.push(a.checked_div(b) else return "overflow")
                else
                    if b == -1
                        if a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                            return "overflow"
                        stack.push(0)
                    else
                        stack.push(a % b)
    stack[0]

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! str
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0 or toks[0].kind != "i"
        if toks.len() == 0
            return
        return "syntax"
    mut start := 1
    mut name := ""
    if toks[0].text == "let"
        if toks.len() < 4 or toks[1].kind != "i" or toks[2].text != "=" or toks[2].kind != "o"
            return "syntax"
        name = toks[1].text
        if name == "let" or name == "print"
            return "syntax"
        start = 3
    elif toks[0].text == "print"
        start = 1
    else
        return "syntax"
    rpn := parse_all(toks, start)?
    for t in rpn
        if t.kind == "i" and not env.contains(t.text)
            return "unknown {t.text}"
    v := eval(rpn, env)?
    if name == ""
        print(v)
    else
        env[name] = v

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        if line.trim_start(' ') .starts_with("#")
            continue
        run_line(line, mut vars) else e
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {e}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

struct Tok
    kind int     # 0 number, 1 name, 2 operator
    text str

struct Node
    kind int     # 0 number, 1 name, 2 negate, 3 binary
    text str
    l int
    r int

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    nodes List[Node]

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn tokenize(s str) List[Tok]?
    cs := s.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    out

fn Parser.is_op(self, t str) bool
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return false
    tk := self.toks[self.pos]
    tk.kind == 2 and tk.text == t

fn Parser.add(mut self, kind int, text str, l int, r int) int
    self.nodes.push(Node(kind: kind, text: text, l: l, r: r))
    self.nodes.len() - 1

fn Parser.primary(mut self) int?
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return none
    tk := self.toks[self.pos]
    if tk.kind == 0
        self.pos += 1
        return self.add(0, tk.text, 0, 0)
    if tk.kind == 1
        if tk.text == "let" or tk.text == "print"
            return none
        self.pos += 1
        return self.add(1, tk.text, 0, 0)
    if tk.text == "("
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.expr() else return none
        if not self.is_op(")")
            return none
        self.pos += 1
        return e
    none

fn Parser.unary(mut self) int?
    if self.is_op("-")
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.unary() else return none
        return self.add(2, "-", e, 0)
    self.primary()

fn Parser.term(mut self) int?
    mut left := self.unary() else return none
    while self.is_op("*") or self.is_op("/") or self.is_op("%")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        right := self.unary() else return none
        left = self.add(3, op, left, right)
    left

fn Parser.expr(mut self) int?
    mut left := self.term() else return none
    while self.is_op("+") or self.is_op("-")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        right := self.term() else return none
        left = self.add(3, op, left, right)
    left

fn eval(nodes List[Node], i int, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    n := nodes[i]
    if n.kind == 0
        return n.text.to_int() else return "overflow"
    if n.kind == 1
        return env[n.text]
    if n.kind == 2
        v := eval(nodes, n.l, env)?
        return 0.checked_sub(v) else return "overflow"
    a := eval(nodes, n.l, env)?
    b := eval(nodes, n.r, env)?
    if n.text == "+"
        return a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
    if n.text == "-"
        return a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
    if n.text == "*"
        return a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
    if b == 0
        return "division by zero"
    if b == -1
        if a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
            return "overflow"
        if n.text == "%"
            return 0
        return 0 - a
    if n.text == "/"
        return a / b
    a % b

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! str
    toks := tokenize(line) else return "syntax"
    mut target := ""
    mut start := 0
    isprint := toks.len() > 0 and toks[0].kind == 1 and toks[0].text == "print"
    islet := toks.len() > 0 and toks[0].kind == 1 and toks[0].text == "let"
    if islet
        if toks.len() < 4 or toks[1].kind != 1 or toks[1].text == "let" or toks[1].text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        if toks[2].kind != 2 or toks[2].text != "="
            return "syntax"
        target = toks[1].text
        start = 3
    elif isprint
        start = 1
    else
        return "syntax"
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: start, nodes: [])
    root := p.expr() else return "syntax"
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for nd in p.nodes
