struct Tok
    kind str
    text str

struct Node
    kind str
    val int
    name str
    l int
    r int

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    nodes List[Node]

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn lex(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: cs[i..j].join("")))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "id", text: cs[i..j].join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn Parser.add(mut self, nd Node) int
    self.nodes.push(nd)
    self.nodes.len() - 1

fn Parser.peek_op(self, s str) bool
    self.pos < self.toks.len() and self.toks[self.pos].kind == "op" and self.toks[self.pos].text == s

fn Parser.primary(mut self) int ! str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == "num"
        self.pos += 1
        v := t.text.to_int() else
            return self.add(Node(kind: "big", val: 0, name: "", l: 0, r: 0))
        return self.add(Node(kind: "num", val: v, name: "", l: 0, r: 0))
    if t.kind == "id"
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return self.add(Node(kind: "var", val: 0, name: t.text, l: 0, r: 0))
    if t.text == "("
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.expr()?
        if not self.peek_op(")")
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return e
    "syntax"

fn Parser.unary(mut self) int ! str
    if self.peek_op("-")
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.unary()?
        return self.add(Node(kind: "neg", val: 0, name: "", l: e, r: 0))
    self.primary()

fn Parser.term(mut self) int ! str
    mut a := self.unary()?
    while self.peek_op("*") or self.peek_op("/") or self.peek_op("%")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        b := self.unary()?
        a = self.add(Node(kind: op, val: 0, name: "", l: a, r: b))
    a

fn Parser.expr(mut self) int ! str
    mut a := self.term()?
    while self.peek_op("+") or self.peek_op("-")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        b := self.term()?
        a = self.add(Node(kind: op, val: 0, name: "", l: a, r: b))
    a

fn first_unknown(p Parser, i int, env Map[str, int]) str?
    nd := p.nodes[i]
    if nd.kind == "var"
        if not env.contains(nd.name)
            return nd.name
        return none
    if nd.kind == "num" or nd.kind == "big"
        return none
    if nd.kind == "neg"
        return first_unknown(p, nd.l, env)
    a := first_unknown(p, nd.l, env)
    if a != none
        return a
    first_unknown(p, nd.r, env)

fn eval(p Parser, i int, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    nd := p.nodes[i]
    if nd.kind == "num"
        return nd.val
    if nd.kind == "big"
        return "overflow"
    if nd.kind == "var"
        return env[nd.name]
    if nd.kind == "neg"
        x := eval(p, nd.l, env)?
        return 0.checked_sub(x) else return "overflow"
    x := eval(p, nd.l, env)?
    y := eval(p, nd.r, env)?
    if nd.kind == "+"
        return x.checked_add(y) else return "overflow"
    if nd.kind == "-"

struct P

    vars Map[str, int]
    run bool
    err str
    ok bool

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok]?
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    out

fn P.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        self.toks[self.pos].text
    else
        ""

fn P.fail(mut self, m str)
    if self.run and self.err == ""
        self.err = m

fn P.primary(mut self) int
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        self.ok = false
        return 0
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    self.pos += 1
    if t.kind == 0
        v := t.text.to_int() else
            self.fail("overflow")
            return 0
        return v
    if t.kind == 1
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            self.ok = false
            return 0
        if self.run
            return self.vars.get(t.text) else 0
        return 0
    if t.text == "("
        v := self.expr()
        if self.peek() == ")"
            self.pos += 1
        else
            self.ok = false
        return v
    self.ok = false
    0

fn P.unary(mut self) int
    if self.peek() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        v := self.unary()
        if not self.run or self.err != ""
            return 0
        r := (0).checked_sub(v) else
            self.fail("overflow")
            return 0
        return r
    self.primary()

fn P.term(mut self) int
    mut a := self.unary()
    while self.ok and (self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%")
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        b := self.unary()
        if self.run and self.err == ""
            if op == "*"
                a = a.checked_mul(b) else
                    self.fail("overflow")
                    0
            elif b == 0
                self.fail("division by zero")
            elif b == -1 and a == (0).checked_sub(9223372036854775807)? - 1
                self.fail("overflow")
            elif op == "/"
                a = a / b
            else
                a = a % b
    a

    mut a := self.term()
    while self.ok and (self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-")
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        b := self.term()
        if self.run and self.err == ""
            if op == "+"
                a = a.checked_add(b) else
                    self.fail("overflow")
                    0
            else
                a = a.checked_sub(b) else
                    self.fail("overflow")
                    0
    a

fn newp(toks List[Tok], start int, vars Map[str, int], run bool) P
    P(toks: toks, pos: start, vars: vars, run: run, err: "", ok: true)

## returns "" when fine, else the error message; binds on success
fn process(line str, mut vars Map[str, int]) str
    toks := tokenize(line) else return "syntax"
    if toks.len() == 0
        return "syntax"
    first := toks[0].text
    is_let := first == "let" and toks[0].kind == 1
    start := if is_let then 3 else 1
    if not is_let and not (first == "print" and toks[0].kind == 1)
        return "syntax"
    if is_let
        if toks.len() < 4 or toks[1].kind != 1 or toks[2].text != "=" or toks[1].text == "let" or toks[1].text == "print"
            return "syntax"
    mut sp := newp(toks, start, vars, false)
    sp.expr()
    if not sp.ok or sp.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for i in start..toks.len()
        if toks[i].kind == 1 and not vars.contains(toks[i].text)
            return "unknown {toks[i].text}"
    mut ep := newp(toks, start, vars, true)
    v := ep.expr()
    if ep.err != ""
        return ep.err
    if is_let
        vars[toks[1].text] = v
    else
        print(v)
    ""

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        cs := line.chars()
        mut i := 0
        while i < cs.len() and cs[i] == ' '
            i += 1
        if i == cs.len() or cs[i] == '#'
            continue
        e := process(line, mut vars)
        if e != ""
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {e}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

struct Tok
    kind int
    text str

struct Op
    kind int
    text str

struct P
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    out List[Op]
    ok bool

fn lex(line str) List[Tok]?
    cs := line.chars()
    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c >= '0' and c <= '9'
            mut j := i
            while j < n and cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9'
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'
            mut j := i
            while j < n and ((cs[j] >= 'a' and cs[j] <= 'z') or (cs[j] >= '0' and cs[j] <= '9') or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: cs.slice(i, j).join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '(' 
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 3, text: "("))
            i += 1
        elif c == ')'
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 4, text: ")"))
            i += 1
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%'
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    toks

fn peek_op(p P, ops str) str
    if p.pos < p.toks.len()
        t := p.toks[p.pos]
        if t.kind == 2 and ops.contains(t.text)
            return t.text
    ""

fn parse_atom(mut p P)
    if p.pos >= p.toks.len()
        p.ok = false
        return
    t := p.toks[p.pos]
    if t.kind == 2 and t.text == "-"
        p.pos += 1
        parse_atom(mut p)
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 3, text: "neg"))
    elif t.kind == 0
        p.pos += 1
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 0, text: t.text))
    elif t.kind == 1 and t.text != "let" and t.text != "print"
        p.pos += 1
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 1, text: t.text))
    elif t.kind == 3
        p.pos += 1
        parse_sum(mut p)
        if not p.ok
            return
        if p.pos < p.toks.len() and p.toks[p.pos].kind == 4
            p.pos += 1
        else
            p.ok = false
    else
        p.ok = false

fn parse_term(mut p P)
    parse_atom(mut p)
    while p.ok
        o := peek_op(p, "*/%")
        if o == ""
            break
        p.pos += 1
        parse_atom(mut p)
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 2, text: o))

fn parse_sum(mut p P)
    parse_term(mut p)
    while p.ok
        o := peek_op(p, "+-")
        if o == ""
            break
        p.pos += 1
        parse_term(mut p)
        p.out.push(Op(kind: 2, text: o))

fn is_name(t Tok) bool
    t.kind == 1 and t.text != "let" and t.text != "print"

fn run_ops(ops List[Op], env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    mut st := List[int]()
    for o in ops
        if o.kind == 0
            v := o.text.to_int() else return "overflow"
            st.push(v)
        elif o.kind == 1
            st.push(env[o.text])
        elif o.kind == 3
            a := st.pop() else 0
            r := 0.checked_sub(a) else return "overflow"
            st.push(r)
        else
            b := st.pop() else 0
            a := st.pop() else 0
            if o.text == "+"
                r := a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            elif o.text == "-"
                r := a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            elif o.text == "*"
                r := a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
                st.push(r)
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if b == -1
                    if a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                        return "overflow"
                    if o.text == "%"
                        st.push(0)
                    else
                        st.push(0 - a)
                elif o.text == "/"
                    st.push(a / b)
                else
                    st.push(a % b)
    st[0]

fn exec(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) int? ! str
    toks := lex(line) else return "syntax"
    if toks.len() == 0
        return none
    first := toks[0]
    if first.kind != 1 or (first.text != "let" and first.text != "print")
        return "syntax"
    is_let := first.text == "let"
    mut start := 1
    if is_let
        if toks.len() < 3 or not is_name(toks[1])
            return "syntax"
        start = 3
    p0 := P(toks: toks, pos: start, out: [], ok: true)
    mut p := p0
    if is_let and not (toks[2].kind == 2 and toks[2].text == "=")
        return "syntax"
    parse_sum(mut p)
    if not p.ok or p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for i in start..toks.len()
        t := toks[i]
        if is_name(t) and not env.contains(t.text)
            return "unknown {t.text}"
    v := run_ops(p.out, env)?
    if is_let
        env[toks[1].text] = v
        return none
    v

fn main()

struct Acc
    hi int
    lo int

struct Tx
    date str
    account str
    amount int
    memo str

fn usage() never
    io.eprint("usage: ledger balance|top N|monthly")
    io.exit(1)

fn add(a Acc, x int) Acc
    q := x / 1000000000
    r := x % 1000000000
    mut hi := a.hi + q
    mut lo := a.lo + r
    if lo < 0
        lo += 1000000000
        hi -= 1
    elif lo >= 1000000000
        lo -= 1000000000
        hi += 1
    Acc(hi: hi, lo: lo)

## sign and magnitude parts (mh * 1e9 + ml) of hi*1e9+lo
fn mag(a Acc) (bool, int, int)
    if a.hi < 0 and a.lo > 0
        (true, -a.hi - 1, 1000000000 - a.lo)
    elif a.hi < 0
        (true, -a.hi, 0)
    else
        (false, a.hi, a.lo)

fn fmt(a Acc) str
    m := mag(a)
    mh := m.1
    ml := m.2
    digits := if mh > 0 then "{mh}{ml:09}" else "{ml}"
    mut d := digits
    while d.len() < 3
        d = "0{d}"
    n := d.len()
    sign := if m.0 and (mh > 0 or ml > 0) then "-" else ""
    "{sign}{d.slice(0, n - 2)}.{d.slice(n - 2, n)}"

fn all_digits(s str) bool
    if s.len() == 0
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if c < '0' or c > '9'
            return false
    true

fn check_date(d str) bool
    if d.len() != 10
        return false
    if d.slice(4, 5) != "-" or d.slice(7, 8) != "-"
        return false
    y := d.slice(0, 4)
    mo := d.slice(5, 7)
    dy := d.slice(8, 10)
    if not all_digits(y) or not all_digits(mo) or not all_digits(dy)
        return false
    m := mo.to_int() else 0
    day := dy.to_int() else 0
    m >= 1 and m <= 12 and day >= 1 and day <= 31

fn main()
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() == 0
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    mut topn := 0
    if cmd == "top"
        if args.len() != 2
            usage()
        if not all_digits(args[1])
            usage()
        topn = args[1].to_int() else usage()
    elif cmd == "balance" or cmd == "monthly"
        if args.len() != 1
            usage()
    else
        usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    mut lines := text.lines()
    if lines.len() > 0 and lines[lines.len() - 1] == ""
        lines.pop()
    if lines.len() == 0 or lines[0] != "date,account,amount_cents,memo"
        io.eprint("error: line 1: bad header")
        io.exit(2)
    mut txs := List[Tx]()
    mut bad := false
    for i, line in lines.enumerate()
        if i == 0
            continue
        parts := line.split(",")
        reason := if parts.len() != 4 then "wrong field count" elif not check_date(parts[0]) then "bad date" elif parts[1] == "" then "empty account" elif not all_digits(parts[2].trim_start("-")) then "bad amount" elif parts[2].to_int() == none then "bad amount" else ""
        if reason != ""
            io.eprint("error: line {i + 1}: {reason}")
            bad = true
            continue
        amt := parts[2].to_int() else 0
        txs.push(Tx(date: parts[0], account: parts[1], amount: amt, memo: parts[3]))
    if cmd == "top"
        keys := [topkey(t, j) for j, t in txs.enumerate()]
        for k in keys.sorted().slice(0, if topn < keys.len() then topn else keys.len())
            t := txs[(k.slice(19, 28).to_int() else 0)]
            print("{t.date}\t{t.account}\t{fmt(add(Acc(hi: 0, lo: 0), t.amount))}\t{t.memo}")
    else
        mut sums := Map[str, Acc]()
        for t in txs
            k := if cmd == "balance" then t.account else t.date.slice(0, 7)
            cur := sums.get(k) else Acc(hi: 0, lo: 0)
            sums[k] = add(cur, t.amount)
        for k in sums.keys().sorted()
            print("{k}\t{fmt(sums[k])}")
    if bad
        io.exit(2)

fn topkey(t Tx, j int) str
    m := mag(add(Acc(hi: 0, lo: 0), t.amount))
    a := 9999999999 - m.1
    b := 999999999 - m.2
    "{a:010}{b:09}{j:09}"

struct Acc
    hi int
    lo int

struct Tx
    date str
    account str
    amount int
    memo str

fn usage() never
    io.eprint("usage: ledger balance|top N|monthly")
    io.exit(1)

fn acc_add(a Acc, x int) Acc
    big := 1000000000
    mut hi := a.hi + x / big
    mut lo := a.lo + x % big
    hi += lo / big
    lo = lo % big
    Acc(hi: hi, lo: lo)

fn fmt(a Acc) str
    mut hi := a.hi
    mut lo := a.lo
    if hi > 0 and lo < 0
        hi -= 1
        lo += 1000000000
    elif hi < 0 and lo > 0
        hi += 1
        lo -= 1000000000
    neg := hi < 0 or lo < 0
    if hi < 0
        hi = -hi
    if lo < 0
        lo = -lo
    mut d := "{lo}"
    if hi != 0
        d = "{hi}{lo:09}"
    while d.len() < 3
        d = "0{d}"
    n := d.len()
    body := "{d.slice(0, n - 2)}.{d.slice(n - 2, n)}"
    if neg
        return "-{body}"
    body

fn all_digits(s str) bool
    if s.len() == 0
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if c < '0' or c > '9'
            return false
    true

fn valid_date(d str) bool
    if d.len() != 10
        return false
    ps := d.split("-")
    if ps.len() != 3
        return false
    if ps[0].len() != 4 or ps[1].len() != 2 or ps[2].len() != 2
        return false
    if not (all_digits(ps[0]) and all_digits(ps[1]) and all_digits(ps[2]))
        return false
    m := ps[1].to_int() else 0
    dd := ps[2].to_int() else 0
    m >= 1 and m <= 12 and dd >= 1 and dd <= 31

fn parse_amount(s str) int?
    mut body := s
    if s.starts_with("-")
        body = s.slice(1, s.len())
    if not all_digits(body)
        return none
    s.to_int()

fn pad(n int) str
    "{n:012}"

fn main() !
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() < 1
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    mut topn := 0
    if cmd == "balance" or cmd == "monthly"
        if args.len() != 1
            usage()
    elif cmd == "top"
        if args.len() != 2
            usage()
        if not all_digits(args[1])
            usage()
        topn = args[1].to_int() else usage()
    else
        usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    mut lines := text.lines()
    if lines.len() > 0 and lines[lines.len() - 1] == ""
        lines.pop()
    if lines.len() == 0 or lines[0] != "date,account,amount_cents,memo"
        io.eprint("error: line 1: bad header")
        io.exit(2)
    mut txs := List[Tx]()
    mut bad := false
    for i in 1..lines.len()
        f := lines[i].split(",")
        k := i + 1
        if f.len() != 4
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: wrong field count")
            bad = true
            continue
        if not valid_date(f[0])
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad date")
            bad = true
            continue
        if f[1] == ""
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: empty account")
            bad = true
            continue
        amt := parse_amount(f[2]) else
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad amount")
            bad = true
            continue
        txs.push(Tx(date: f[0], account: f[1], amount: amt, memo: f[3]))
    if cmd == "balance" or cmd == "monthly"
        mut m := Map[str, Acc]()
        for t in txs
            key := if cmd == "balance" then t.account else t.date.slice(0, 7)
            cur := m.get(key) else Acc(hi: 0, lo: 0)
            m[key] = acc_add(cur, t.amount)
        for key in m.keys().sorted()
            print("{key}\t{fmt(m[key])}")
    else
        mut keyed := []
        for i, t in txs.enumerate()
            mag := if t.amount < 0 then "{t.amount}".slice(1, 30) else "{t.amount}"
            padded := "{mag:>20}".replace(" ", "0")
            keyed.push("{padded}{pad(999999999999 - i)}")
        order := keyed.sorted().reversed()
        mut shown := 0
        for ks in order
            if shown >= topn
                break
            i := 999999999999 - (ks.slice(20, 32).to_int() else 0)
            t := txs[i]
            print("{t.date}\t{t.account}\t{fmt(acc_add(Acc(hi: 0, lo: 0), t.amount))}\t{t.memo}")
            shown += 1
    if bad
        io.exit(2)

struct Tx

    account str
    amount int
    memo str

fn usage() never

fn money(b bigint) str

    body := "{padded.slice(0, n - 2)}.{padded.slice(n - 2)}"

    Tx(date: parts[0], account: parts[1], amount: n, memo: parts[3])

fn main()
    args := env.args()

        ls.pop()

        io.eprint("error: line 1: bad header")

    for i in 1..ls.len()
        r := parse_line(ls[i])
        if t := r
            txs.push(t)
        else err
            io.eprint("error: line {i + 1}: {err}")
            bad = true
    if cmd == "balance"
        mut m := Map[str, bigint]()
        for t in txs
            cur := m.get(t.account) else bigint.from_int(0)
            m[t.account] = cur + bigint.from_int(t.amount)
        for k in m.keys().sorted()
            print("{k}\t{money(m[k])}")
    elif cmd == "monthly"
        mut m := Map[str, bigint]()
        for t in txs
            k := t.date.slice(0, 7)
            cur := m.get(k) else bigint.from_int(0)
            m[k] = cur + bigint.from_int(t.amount)
        for k in m.keys().sorted()
            print("{k}\t{money(m[k])}")
    else
        sorted := txs.sorted(by: |t| (-(abs_half(t.amount)), -(t.amount % 2).abs()))
        for t in sorted.take(topn)
            print("{t.date}\t{t.account}\t{money_int(t.amount)}\t{t.memo}")
    if bad
        io.exit(2)

fn abs_half(a int) int
    h := a / 2
    if h < 0 then -h else h

    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif c.is_digit()
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < cs.len() and cs[j].is_digit()
                t = "{t}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: t))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or cs[j].is_digit() or cs[j] == '_')
                t = "{t}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "name", text: t))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn is_op(toks List[Tok], pos int, s str) bool
    if pos >= toks.len()
        return false
    toks[pos].kind == "op" and toks[pos].text == s

fn parse_atom(toks List[Tok], mut pos int) Expr ! str
    if pos >= toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := toks[pos]
    if t.kind == "num"
        pos += 1
        return Num(text: t.text)
    if t.kind == "name"
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        pos += 1
        return Var(name: t.text)
    if is_op(toks, pos, "-")
        pos += 1
        e := parse_atom(toks, mut pos)?
        return Neg(e: e)
    if is_op(toks, pos, "(")
        pos += 1
        e := parse_sum(toks, mut pos)?
        if not is_op(toks, pos, ")")
            return "syntax"
        pos += 1
        return e
    "syntax"

fn parse_term(toks List[Tok], mut pos int) Expr ! str
    mut l := parse_atom(toks, mut pos)?
    while is_op(toks, pos, "*") or is_op(toks, pos, "/") or is_op(toks, pos, "%")
        op := toks[pos].text
        pos += 1
        r := parse_atom(toks, mut pos)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn parse_sum(toks List[Tok], mut pos int) Expr ! str
    mut l := parse_term(toks, mut pos)?
    while is_op(toks, pos, "+") or is_op(toks, pos, "-")
        op := toks[pos].text
        pos += 1
        r := parse_term(toks, mut pos)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

    match e

        Var(n) =>
            if env.contains(n)
                none

                n
        Neg(x) => first_unknown(x, env)
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := first_unknown(l, env)
            if a != none
                return a
            first_unknown(r, env)

    match e
        Num(t) =>
            n := t.to_int() else return "overflow"
            n
        Var(n) => env[n]

            v := eval(x, env)?
            r := (0).checked_sub(v) else return "overflow"
            r
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                x := a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if op == "-"
                x := a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if op == "*"
                x := a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if b == 0
                return "division by zero"
            if b == -1 and a == (-9223372036854775807 - 1)
                return "overflow"
            if op == "/"
                return a / b
            a % b

    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0

    if toks[0].kind == "name" and toks[0].text == "print"

        u := first_unknown(e, env)
        if u != none
            return "unknown {u else \"\"}"
        v := eval(e, env)?
        print(v)
        return none
    "syntax"

fn main() !
    "x"

struct P
    toks List[str]
    pos int
    out List[str]

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[str] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut toks := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            toks.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            toks.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    toks

fn P.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        return self.toks[self.pos]
    ""

fn P.primary(mut self) ! str
    t := self.peek()
    if t == ""
        return "syntax"
    c := t.char_at(0) else ' '
    if is_digit(c) or (is_lower(c) and t != "let" and t != "print")
        self.out.push(t)
        self.pos += 1
    elif t == "("
        self.pos += 1
        self.expr()?
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
    else
        return "syntax"

fn P.unary(mut self) ! str
    if self.peek() == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        self.unary()?
        self.out.push("neg")
    else
        self.primary()?

fn P.term(mut self) ! str
    self.unary()?
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        self.unary()?
        self.out.push(op)

fn P.expr(mut self) ! str
    self.term()?
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        self.term()?
        self.out.push(op)

# returns the rpn of tokens from `start` to the end
fn parse_expr(toks List[str], start int) List[str] ! str
    mut p := P(toks: toks, pos: start, out: List[str]())
    p.expr()?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    p.out

fn eval(rpn List[str], env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    for t in rpn
        c := t.char_at(0) else ' '
        if is_lower(c) and t != "neg" and not env.contains(t)
            return "unknown {t}"
    mut st := List[int]()
    for t in rpn
        c := t.char_at(0) else ' '
        if is_digit(c)
            v := t.to_int() else return "overflow"
            st.push(v)
        elif t == "neg"
            a := st.pop() else 0
            r := a.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
            st.push(r)
        elif is_lower(c) and t != "neg"
            st.push(env[t])
        else
            b := st.pop() else 0
            a := st.pop() else 0
            mut r := 0
            if t == "+"
                r = a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
            elif t == "-"
                r = a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
            elif t == "*"
                r = a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if b == -1 and a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                    return "overflow"
                if t == "/"
                    r = a / b
                else
                    r = a % b
            st.push(r)
    st[0]

fn run_line(line str, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return 0
    if toks[0] == "let"
        if toks.len() < 4 or toks[2] != "="
            return "syntax"
        n := toks[1]
        c := n.char_at(0) else ' '
        if not is_lower(c) or n == "let" or n == "print"
            return "syntax"
        rpn := parse_expr(toks, 3)?
        v := eval(rpn, env)?
        env[n] = v
    elif toks[0] == "print"
        rpn := parse_expr(toks, 1)?
        v := eval(rpn, env)?
        print(v)
    else
        return "syntax"
    0

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        mut first := ' '
        for c in line.chars()
            if c != ' '
                first = c
                break
        if first == ' ' or first == '#'
            continue
        run_line(line, vars) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

struct P
    toks List[str]
    pos int

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_dig(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn tokenize(s str) List[str] ! str
    cs := s.chars()
    mut out := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_dig(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_dig(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push(cs.slice(i, j).join(""))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_dig(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(cs.slice(i, j).join(""))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn peek(p P) str
    if p.pos < p.toks.len()
        p.toks[p.pos]
    else
        ""

fn kind(t str) str
    c := t.char_at(0) else return "end"
    if is_dig(c)
        "num"
    elif is_lower(c)
        if t == "let" or t == "print"
            "kw"
        else
            "name"
    else
        t

fn parse_atom(mut p P) Expr ! str
    t := peek(p)
    k := kind(t)
    if k == "num"
        p.pos += 1
        return Num(text: t)
    if k == "name"
        p.pos += 1
        return Var(name: t)
    if k == "-"
        p.pos += 1
        e := parse_atom(mut p)?
        return Neg(e: e)
    if k == "("
        p.pos += 1
        e := parse_add(mut p)?
        if peek(p) != ")"
            return "syntax"
        p.pos += 1
        return e
    "syntax"

fn parse_mul(mut p P) Expr ! str
    mut l := parse_atom(mut p)?
    while peek(p) == "*" or peek(p) == "/" or peek(p) == "%"
        op := peek(p)
        p.pos += 1
        r := parse_atom(mut p)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn parse_add(mut p P) Expr ! str
    mut l := parse_mul(mut p)?
    while peek(p) == "+" or peek(p) == "-"
        op := peek(p)
        p.pos += 1
        r := parse_mul(mut p)?
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

    match e
        Num(t) => none
        Var(n) => if env.contains(n)

            n
        Neg(x) => first_unknown(x, env)
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := first_unknown(l, env)
            if a != none
                return a
            first_unknown(r, env)

    match e
        Num(t) => t.to_int() else return "overflow"
        Var(n) => env[n]
        Neg(x) =>
            v := eval(x, env)?
            v.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
            elif op == "-"
                a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
            elif op == "*"
                a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
            else
                if b == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if b == -1 and a == -9223372036854775807 - 1
                    return "overflow"
                if op == "/"
                    a / b
                else
                    a % b

    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return ""
    mut p := P(toks: toks, pos: 0)

    mut name := ""
    if first == "print"

    elif first == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3 or kind(toks[1]) != "name" or toks[2] != "="
            return "syntax"
        name = toks[1]
        p.pos = 3
    else
        return "syntax"
    e := parse_add(mut p)?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"

    if u != none
        return "unknown {u else ""}"
    v := eval(e, env)?
    if name == ""
        return "{v}"
    env[name] = v
    ""

fn main() !
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut n := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        n += 1
        t := line.trim()
        if line.starts_with("#") or (t == "" and not line.contains("\t") and not line.contains("\r"))
            continue
        if line.trim_start().starts_with("#") and not line.starts_with("\t")
            continue
        r := run_line(line, mut vars) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {n}: {err}")
            failed = true
            continue
        if r != ""
            print(r)
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

struct P
    toks List[str]
    pos int
    kind List[int]
    op List[str]
    lhs List[int]
    rhs List[int]
    txt List[str]

fn is_lower(c str) bool
    c >= "a" and c <= "z"

fn is_digit(c str) bool
    c >= "0" and c <= "9"

fn lex(line str) List[str] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    n := cs.len()
    mut out := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < n
        c := cs[i].to_str()
        if c == " "
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and is_digit(cs[j].to_str())
                j += 1
            out.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i + 1
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j].to_str()) or is_digit(cs[j].to_str()) or cs[j].to_str() == "_")
                j += 1
            out.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif "+-*/%()=".contains(c)
            out.push(c)
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn is_name(t str) bool
    is_lower(t.slice(0, 1)) and t != "let" and t != "print"

fn add(mut p P, k int, op str, l int, r int, t str) int
    p.kind.push(k)
    p.op.push(op)
    p.lhs.push(l)
    p.rhs.push(r)
    p.txt.push(t)
    p.kind.len() - 1

fn peek(p P) str
    if p.pos < p.toks.len()
        p.toks[p.pos]
    else
        ""

fn parse_atom(mut p P) int ! str
    t := peek(p)
    if t == ""
        return "syntax"
    p.pos += 1
    if t == "-"
        e := parse_atom(mut p)?
        return add(mut p, 2, "-", e, 0, "")
    if t == "("
        e := parse_expr(mut p)?
        if peek(p) != ")"
            return "syntax"
        p.pos += 1
        return e
    if is_digit(t.slice(0, 1))
        return add(mut p, 0, "", 0, 0, t)
    if is_name(t)
        return add(mut p, 1, "", 0, 0, t)
    "syntax"

fn parse_term(mut p P) int ! str
    mut l := parse_atom(mut p)?
    while peek(p) == "*" or peek(p) == "/" or peek(p) == "%"
        o := peek(p)
        p.pos += 1
        r := parse_atom(mut p)?
        l = add(mut p, 3, o, l, r, "")
    l

fn parse_expr(mut p P) int ! str
    mut l := parse_term(mut p)?
    while peek(p) == "+" or peek(p) == "-"
        o := peek(p)
        p.pos += 1
        r := parse_term(mut p)?
        l = add(mut p, 3, o, l, r, "")
    l

fn eval(p P, vars Map[str, int], n int) int ! str
    k := p.kind[n]
    if k == 0
        v := p.txt[n].to_int() else return "overflow"
        return v
    if k == 1
        return vars[p.txt[n]]
    if k == 2
        a := eval(p, vars, p.lhs[n])?
        r := 0.checked_sub(a) else return "overflow"
        return r
    a := eval(p, vars, p.lhs[n])?
    b := eval(p, vars, p.rhs[n])?
    o := p.op[n]
    if o == "+"
        r := a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
        return r
    if o == "-"
        r := a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
        return r
    if o == "*"
        r := a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
        return r
    if b == 0
        return "division by zero"
    if o == "/"
        r := a.checked_div(b) else return "overflow"
        return r
    r := a.checked_rem(b) else return "overflow"
    r

fn run_line(line str, mut vars Map[str, int], mut out List[str]) int ! str
    if line.trim_start().starts_with("#")
        return 0
    toks := lex(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0
        return 0
    mut p := P(toks: toks, pos: 1, kind: List[int](), op: List[str](), lhs: List[int](), rhs: List[int](), txt: List[str]())
    mut target := ""
    if toks[0] == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3 or not is_name(toks[1]) or toks[2] != "="
            return "syntax"
        target = toks[1]
        p.pos = 3
    elif toks[0] != "print"
        return "syntax"
    root := parse_expr(mut p)?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for i in 0..p.kind.len()
        if p.kind[i] == 1 and not vars.contains(p.txt[i])
            return "unknown {p.txt[i]}"
    v := eval(p, vars, root)?
    if target != ""
        vars[target] = v
        return 0
    out.push("{v}")
    0

fn main() !
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for raw in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        line := raw
        mut out := List[str]()
        run_line(line, mut vars, mut out) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            failed = true
            0
        for r in out
            print(r)
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

struct P
    toks List[str]
    pos int
    env Map[str, int]
    ev bool

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn tokenize(line str) List[str] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[str]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < n and is_digit(cs[j])
                t = "{t}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(t)
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            mut t := ""
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                t = "{t}{cs[j]}"
                j += 1
            out.push(t)
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn is_name(t str) bool
    if t == "let" or t == "print"
        return false
    match t.char_at(0)
        none => false
        c => is_lower(c)

fn P.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        self.toks[self.pos]
    else
        ""

fn P.atom(mut self) int ! str
    t := self.peek()
    if t == ""
        return "syntax"
    if t == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        v := self.atom()?
        if not self.ev
            return 0
        return 0.checked_sub(v) else return "overflow"
    if t == "("
        self.pos += 1
        v := self.sum()?
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return v
    c := t.char_at(0) else return "syntax"
    if is_digit(c)
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.ev
            return 0
        return t.to_int() else return "overflow"
    if is_name(t)
        self.pos += 1
        if not self.ev
            return 0
        return self.env[t]
    "syntax"

fn P.term(mut self) int ! str
    mut v := self.atom()?
    while true
        t := self.peek()
        if t != "*" and t != "/" and t != "%"
            break
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.atom()?
        if self.ev
            if t == "*"
                v = v.checked_mul(r) else return "overflow"
            else
                if r == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if t == "/"
                    v = v.checked_div(r) else return "overflow"
                else
                    v = v.checked_rem(r) else return "overflow"
    v

fn P.sum(mut self) int ! str
    mut v := self.term()?
    while true
        t := self.peek()
        if t != "+" and t != "-"
            break
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        if self.ev
            if t == "+"
                v = v.checked_add(r) else return "overflow"
            else
                v = v.checked_sub(r) else return "overflow"
    v

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) ! str
    toks := tokenize(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0 or toks[0] == "#"
        return
    mut start := 1
    mut target := ""
    if toks[0] == "let"
        if toks.len() < 4 or not is_name(toks[1]) or toks[2] != "="
            return "syntax"
        target = toks[1]
        start = 3
    elif toks[0] != "print"
        return "syntax"
    mut p := P(toks: toks, pos: start, env: env, ev: false)
    p.sum()?
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    for k in start..toks.len()
        if is_name(toks[k]) and not env.contains(toks[k])
            return "unknown {toks[k]}"
    p.pos = start
    p.ev = true
    v := p.sum()?
    if target == ""
        print(v)
    else
        env[target] = v

fn main() !
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut env := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for raw in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        line := raw.trim_start_spaces()
        run_line(line, mut env) else err
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {err}")
            failed = true
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

struct Item
    kind int      # 0 num, 1 name, 2 binary op, 3 neg
    text str

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    out List[Item]

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

    cs := line.chars()
    mut toks := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: line.slice(i, j)))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            toks.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    toks

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        t := self.toks[self.pos]
        if t.kind == 2
            return t.text
    ""

fn parse_atom(mut p Parser) bool
    if p.pos >= p.toks.len()
        return false
    t := p.toks[p.pos]
    if t.kind == 0
        p.out.push(Item(kind: 0, text: t.text))
        p.pos += 1
        return true
    if t.kind == 1
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return false
        p.out.push(Item(kind: 1, text: t.text))
        p.pos += 1
        return true
    if t.text == "-"
        p.pos += 1
        if not parse_atom(mut p)
            return false
        p.out.push(Item(kind: 3, text: "-"))
        return true
    if t.text == "("
        p.pos += 1
        if not parse_expr(mut p)
            return false
        if p.peek() != ")"
            return false
        p.pos += 1
        return true
    false

fn parse_term(mut p Parser) bool
    if not parse_atom(mut p)
        return false
    while p.peek() == "*" or p.peek() == "/" or p.peek() == "%"
        op := p.peek()
        p.pos += 1
        if not parse_atom(mut p)
            return false
        p.out.push(Item(kind: 2, text: op))

    elif toks[0].kind == 1 and toks[0].text == "print"

    else

    items := parse_from(toks, start) else return "syntax"
    for it in items
        if it.kind == 1 and not env.contains(it.text)
            return "unknown {it.text}"
    v := eval(items, env) else err
        return err
    if name == ""
        print(v)

enum Node
    Num(text str)
    Name(id str)
    Neg(e Node)
    Bin(op str, l Node, r Node)

struct Parser
    toks List[str]
    pos int

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

# tokens, or none on an invalid character
fn tokenize(s str) List[str]?
    mut out := List[str]()
    cs := s.chars()
    n := cs.len()
    mut i := 0
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and is_digit(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push(s.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                j += 1
            out.push(s.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push("{c}")
            i += 1
        else
            return none
    out

fn Parser.peek(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len()
        self.toks[self.pos]
    else
        ""

fn Parser.sum(mut self) Node?
    mut l := self.term() else return none
    while self.peek() == "+" or self.peek() == "-"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term() else return none
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.term(mut self) Node?
    mut l := self.unary() else return none
    while self.peek() == "*" or self.peek() == "/" or self.peek() == "%"
        op := self.peek()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.unary() else return none
        l = Bin(op: op, l: l, r: r)
    l

fn Parser.unary(mut self) Node?
    t := self.peek()
    if t == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.unary() else return none
        return Neg(e: e)
    if t == "("
        self.pos += 1
        e := self.sum() else return none
        if self.peek() != ")"
            return none
        self.pos += 1
        return e
    if t == ""
        return none
    c := t.char_at(0) else return none
    if is_digit(c)
        self.pos += 1
        return Num(text: t)
    if is_lower(c)
        self.pos += 1
        return Name(id: t)
    none

fn first_unknown(n Node, env Map[str, int]) str?
    match n
        Num(t) => none
        Name(id) =>
            if env.contains(id)
                none
            else
                id
        Neg(e) => first_unknown(e, env)
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := first_unknown(l, env)
            if a != none
                a
            else
                first_unknown(r, env)

fn eval(n Node, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    match n
        Num(t) =>
            v := t.to_int() else return "overflow"
            v
        Name(id) => env[id]
        Neg(e) =>
            v := eval(e, env)?
            r := v.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
            r
        Bin(op, l, r) =>
            a := eval(l, env)?
            b := eval(r, env)?
            if op == "+"
                x := a.checked_add(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if op == "-"
                x := a.checked_sub(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if op == "*"
                x := a.checked_mul(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if b == 0
                return "division by zero"
            if op == "/"
                x := a.checked_div(b) else return "overflow"
                return x
            if b == -1
                return 0
            a % b

# Ok: returns error message or ""
fn run_line(line str, env Map[str, int]) str
    trimmed := line.trim()
    if trimmed == "" and not line.contains("\t") and not line.contains("\r")
        return ""
    toks := tokenize(line) else return "syntax"
    if toks.len() == 0
        return ""
    if toks[0].starts_with("#")
        return ""
    return exec(toks, env)

fn exec(toks List[str], env Map[str, int]) str
    mut p := Parser(toks: toks, pos: 1)
    head := toks[0]
    mut name := ""
    if head == "let"
        if toks.len() < 3 or toks[2] != "="
            return "syntax"
        nm := toks[1]
        c := nm.char_at(0) else return "syntax"
        if not is_lower(c) or nm == "let" or nm == "print"
            return "syntax"
        name = nm
        p.pos = 3
    elif head != "print"
        return "syntax"
    ast := p.sum() else return "syntax"
    if p.pos != toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    u := first_unknown(ast, env)
    if u != none
        return "unknown {u else ""}"
    v := eval(ast, env) else err
        return err
    if head == "let"
        env[name] = v
    else
        print(v)
    ""

fn main()
    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        msg := run_line(line, vars)
        if msg != ""
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {msg}")
            failed = true
    if failed

    Var(name str)
    Neg(e Expr)
    Bin(op str, l Expr, r Expr)

struct Parser
    toks List[str]
    pos int

    "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(t.slice(0, 1))

fn is_num(t str) bool
    "0123456789".contains(t.slice(0, 1))

fn tokenize(line str) List[str] ! str
    mut toks := List[str]()
    cs := line.chars()
    n := cs.len()
    mut i := 0
    while i < n
        c := line.slice(i, i + 1)
        if c == " "
            i += 1
        elif "0123456789".contains(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and "0123456789".contains(line.slice(j, j + 1))
                j += 1
            toks.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j
        elif "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(c)
            mut j := i
            while j < n and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_".contains(line.slice(j, j + 1))
                j += 1
            toks.push(line.slice(i, j))
            i = j

    if env.args().len() > 0
        io.eprint("usage: calc")
        io.exit(1)
    text := io.read_all()
    mut vars := Map[str, int]()
    mut failed := false

        msg := run_line(line, vars)
        if msg != none
            failed = true
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: {msg else ""}")
    if failed
        io.exit(2)

struct Tok
    kind int
    text str

struct Node
    kind int
    op str
    a int
    b int
    text str

struct P
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    nodes List[Node]

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn lex(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    while i < cs.len()
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            mut parts := List[str]()
            while j < cs.len() and is_digit(cs[j])
                parts.push("{cs[j]}")
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 0, text: parts.join("")))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            mut parts := List[str]()
            while j < cs.len() and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                parts.push("{cs[j]}")
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: 1, text: parts.join("")))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: 2, text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

fn P.peek_op(self) str
    if self.pos < self.toks.len() and self.toks[self.pos].kind == 2
        return self.toks[self.pos].text
    ""

fn P.add(mut self, n Node) int
    self.nodes.push(n)
    self.nodes.len() - 1

fn P.primary(mut self) int ! str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == 0
        self.pos += 1
        return self.add(Node(kind: 0, op: "", a: 0, b: 0, text: t.text))
    if t.kind == 1
        if t.text == "let" or t.text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return self.add(Node(kind: 1, op: "", a: 0, b: 0, text: t.text))
    if t.text == "-"
        self.pos += 1
        x := self.primary()?
        return self.add(Node(kind: 2, op: "", a: x, b: 0, text: ""))
    if t.text == "("
        self.pos += 1
        x := self.expr()?
        if self.peek_op() != ")"
            return "syntax"
        self.pos += 1
        return x
    "syntax"

fn P.term(mut self) int ! str
    mut l := self.primary()?
    while self.peek_op() == "*" or self.peek_op() == "/" or self.peek_op() == "%"
        op := self.peek_op()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.primary()?
        l = self.add(Node(kind: 3, op: op, a: l, b: r, text: ""))
    l

fn P.expr(mut self) int ! str
    mut l := self.term()?
    while self.peek_op() == "+" or self.peek_op() == "-"
        op := self.peek_op()
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        l = self.add(Node(kind: 3, op: op, a: l, b: r, text: ""))
    l

fn eval(nodes List[Node], i int, env Map[str, int]) int ! str
    n := nodes[i]
    if n.kind == 0
        return n.text.to_int() else return "overflow"
    if n.kind == 1
        return env[n.text]
    if n.kind == 2
        x := eval(nodes, n.a, env)?
        return x.checked_neg() else return "overflow"
    l := eval(nodes, n.a, env)?
    r := eval(nodes, n.b, env)?
    if n.op == "+"
        return l.checked_add(r) else return "overflow"
    if n.op == "-"
        return l.checked_sub(r) else return "overflow"
    if n.op == "*"
        return l.checked_mul(r) else return "overflow"
    if r == 0
        return "division by zero"
    if n.op == "/"
        return l.checked_div(r) else return "overflow"
    if r == -1 and l == -9223372036854775807 - 1
        return "overflow"
    l.checked_rem(r) else return "overflow"

fn run_line(line str, mut env Map[str, int]) str ! str
    toks := lex(line)?
    if toks.len() == 0 or toks[0].kind != 1
        return "syntax"
    mut p := P(toks: toks, pos: 1, nodes: List[Node]())
    mut target := ""
    is_let := toks[0].text == "let"
    if is_let
        if toks.len() < 3 or toks[1].kind != 1 or toks[2].text != "="
            return "syntax"
        if toks[1].text == "let" or toks[1].text == "print"
            return "syntax"
        target = toks[1].text
        p.pos = 3
    elif toks[0].text != "print"
        return "syntax"

            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "{c}"))
            i += 1

    t.kind == "name" and (t.text == "let" or t.text == "print")

    t.kind == "op" and t.text == s

    if pos >= toks.len()

        pos += 1
        out.push(Item(kind: "n", text: t.text))
        return true
    if t.kind == "name"
        if is_kw(t)

        pos += 1
        out.push(Item(kind: "v", text: t.text))
        return true
    if is_op(t, "-")
        pos += 1
        if not parse_atom(toks, mut pos, mut out)

        pos += 1

                if b == -1

    v := eval(items, vars)?
    if target == ""

struct Tok
    kind str
    text str

fn is_lower(c char) bool
    c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'

fn is_digit(c char) bool
    c >= '0' and c <= '9'

fn tokenize(line str) List[Tok] ! str
    cs := line.chars()
    mut out := List[Tok]()
    mut i := 0
    n := cs.len()
    while i < n
        c := cs[i]
        if c == ' '
            i += 1
        elif is_digit(c)
            mut j := i
            mut buf := List[char]()
            while j < n and is_digit(cs[j])
                buf.push(cs[j])
                j += 1
            out.push(Tok(kind: "num", text: buf.join("")))
            i = j
        elif is_lower(c)
            mut j := i
            mut buf := List[char]()
            while j < n and (is_lower(cs[j]) or is_digit(cs[j]) or cs[j] == '_')
                buf.push(cs[j])
                j += 1
            w := buf.join("")
            k := if w == "let" or w == "print" then "kw" else "name"
            out.push(Tok(kind: k, text: w))
            i = j
        elif c == '+' or c == '-' or c == '*' or c == '/' or c == '%' or c == '(' or c == ')' or c == '='
            out.push(Tok(kind: "op", text: "{c}"))
            i += 1
        else
            return "syntax"
    out

struct Parser
    toks List[Tok]
    pos int
    run bool
    env Map[str, int]

fn Parser.peek(self, t str) bool
    self.pos < self.toks.len() and self.toks[self.pos].kind == "op" and self.toks[self.pos].text == t

fn Parser.expr(mut self) int ! str
    mut v := self.term()?
    while self.peek("+") or self.peek("-")
        plus := self.peek("+")
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.term()?
        if self.run
            res := if plus then v.checked_add(r) else v.checked_sub(r)
            v = res else return "overflow"
    v

fn Parser.term(mut self) int ! str
    mut v := self.unary()?
    while self.peek("*") or self.peek("/") or self.peek("%")
        op := self.toks[self.pos].text
        self.pos += 1
        r := self.unary()?
        if self.run
            if op == "*"
                v = v.checked_mul(r) else return "overflow"
            else
                if r == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if op == "/"
                    v = v.checked_div(r) else return "overflow"
                else
                    v = v.checked_rem(r) else return "overflow"
    v

fn Parser.unary(mut self) int ! str
    if self.peek("-")
        self.pos += 1
        v := self.unary()?
        if self.run
            return 0.checked_sub(v) else return "overflow"
        return 0
    self.primary()?

fn Parser.primary(mut self) int ! str
    if self.pos >= self.toks.len()
        return "syntax"
    t := self.toks[self.pos]
    if t.kind == "num"
        self.pos += 1
        if self.run
            return t.text.to_int() else return "overflow"
        return 0
    if t.kind == "name"
        self.pos += 1
        if self.run

fn valid_name(s str) bool
    if s.len() == 0
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        ok := (c >= 'a' and c <= 'z') or (c >= 'A' and c <= 'Z') or (c >= '0' and c <= '9') or c == '_' or c == '.' or c == '-'
        if not ok
            return false
    true

fn reach(adj Map[str, Set[str]], start str) Set[str]
    seen := Set[str]()
    mut stack := [start]
    while stack.len() > 0
        cur := stack.pop() else break
        for nx in adj[cur].sorted()
            if not seen.contains(nx)
                seen.add(nx)
                stack.push(nx)
    seen

fn usage() int
    io.eprint("usage: depgraph order|cycles|deps NAME|rdeps NAME")
    io.exit(1)
    1

fn main() !
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() < 1
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    ok := (cmd == "order" or cmd == "cycles") and args.len() == 1
    ok2 := (cmd == "deps" or cmd == "rdeps") and args.len() == 2
    if not (ok or ok2)
        usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    adj := Map[str, Set[str]]()
    radj := Map[str, Set[str]]()
    mut bad := false
    lines := text.split("\n")
    for i in 0..lines.len()
        line := lines[i]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        parts := line.split(" -> ")
        mut good := parts.len() <= 2
        if good
            for p in parts
                if not valid_name(p)
                    good = false
        if not good
            io.eprint("error: line {i + 1}: bad line")
            bad = true
            continue
        for p in parts
            if not adj.contains(p)
                adj[p] = Set[str]()
                radj[p] = Set[str]()
        if parts.len() == 2
            adj[parts[0]].add(parts[1])
            radj[parts[1]].add(parts[0])
    names := adj.keys().sorted()
    mut code := 0
    if bad
        code = 2
    if cmd == "order"
        mut indeg := Map[str, int]()
        for n in names
            indeg[n] = adj[n].len()
        mut out := List[str]()
        mut done := Set[str]()
        while true
            mut pick := ""
            mut found := false
            for n in names
                if not done.contains(n) and indeg[n] == 0
                    pick = n
                    found = true
                    break
            if not found
                break
            done.add(pick)
            out.push(pick)
            for m in radj[pick].sorted()
                indeg[m] = indeg[m] - 1
        if out.len() < names.len()
            io.eprint("error: cycle")
            io.exit(3)
        for n in out
            print(n)
    elif cmd == "cycles"
        for n in names
            if reach(adj, n).contains(n)
                print(n)
    else
        target := args[1]
        if not adj.contains(target)
            io.eprint("error: unknown {target}")
            io.exit(4)
        g := if cmd == "deps" then adj else radj
        for n in reach(g, target).sorted()
            print(n)
    io.exit(code)

    true

    mut seen := Set[str]()
    mut stack := [start]
    while stack.len() > 0

        for nx in adj[cur].sorted()
            if not seen.contains(nx)

                stack.push(nx)

    if s.byte_len() == 0

            return false
    true

fn reach(adj Map[str, List[str]], start str) Set[str]
    seen := Set[str]()
    mut stack := adj.get_or(start, [])
    while stack.len() > 0
        n := stack.pop() else none
        if not seen.contains(n)
            seen.add(n)
            for m in adj.get_or(n, [])
                stack.push(m)
    seen

fn usage() int
    io.eprint("usage: depgraph order|cycles|deps NAME|rdeps NAME")
    1

fn run() int
    args := env.args()
    if args.len() < 1

    ok := (cmd == "order" or cmd == "cycles") and args.len() == 1
    ok2 := (cmd == "deps" or cmd == "rdeps") and args.len() == 2
    if not ok and not ok2
        return usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    mut bad := false
    mut names := Set[str]()
    mut adj := Map[str, List[str]]()
    mut radj := Map[str, List[str]]()
    mut edges := Set[str]()

        k += 1
        if line.byte_len() == 0 or line.starts_with("#")

        if parts.len() == 1 and valid_name(parts[0])
            names.add(parts[0])
        elif parts.len() == 3 and parts[1] == "->" and valid_name(parts[0]) and valid_name(parts[2])
            a := parts[0]
            b := parts[2]
            names.add(a)
            names.add(b)
            if not edges.contains(line)
                edges.add(line)
                l := adj.get_or(a, [])
                l.push(b)
                adj[a] = l
                r := radj.get_or(b, [])
                r.push(a)
                radj[b] = r

        n := stack.pop() else break
        for m in adj[n].sorted()
            if not seen.contains(m)
                seen.add(m)
                stack.push(m)
    seen

        mut from := ""
        mut to := ""
        mut ok := false
        if line.contains(" -> ")
            parts := line.split(" -> ")
            if parts.len() == 2 and valid_name(parts[0]) and valid_name(parts[1])
                from = parts[0]
                to = parts[1]
                ok = true
        elif valid_name(line)
            from = line
            ok = true
        if not ok
            bad = true
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad line")
            continue
        if not adj.contains(from)
            adj[from] = Set[str]()
        if to != ""
            if not adj.contains(to)
                adj[to] = Set[str]()
            adj[from].add(to)
    names := adj.keys().sorted()
    mut code := 0

        for n in names

        mut out := List[str]()

        while out.len() < names.len()

            for n in names

                        if not done.contains(m)

                    if ready
                        pick = n
                        break
            if pick == ""
                io.eprint("error: cycle")
                io.exit(3)
            done.add(pick)
            out.push(pick)
        for n in out
            print(n)
    elif cmd == "cycles"
        for n in names
            if reach(adj, n).contains(n)
                print(n)
    elif cmd == "deps"
        name := a[1]
        if not adj.contains(name)
            io.eprint("error: unknown {name}")
            io.exit(4)
        for n in reach(adj, name).sorted()
            print(n)
    else
        name := a[1]
        if not adj.contains(name)
            io.eprint("error: unknown {name}")
            io.exit(4)
        for n in names
            if reach(adj, n).contains(name)

    if bad

        if seen.add(d)
            stack.push(d)
    while top := stack.pop()
        for d in adj[top]
            if seen.add(d)
                stack.push(d)
    seen

        elif valid_name(line)

        if not adj.contains(a)

fn valid_name(s str) bool
    if s.len() == 0
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        ok := match c
            'a'..='z' => true
            'A'..='Z' => true
            '0'..='9' => true
            '_' | '.' | '-' => true
            _ => false
        if not ok
            return false
    true

fn reach(g Map[str, Set[str]], start str) Set[str]
    mut seen := Set[str]()
    mut stack := List[str]()
    for d in g[start].sorted()
        stack.push(d)
    while top := stack.pop()
        if seen.contains(top)
            continue
        seen.insert(top)
        for d in g[top].sorted()
            if not seen.contains(d)
                stack.push(d)
    seen

fn usage() !
    io.eprint("usage: depgraph order|cycles|deps NAME|rdeps NAME")
    io.exit(1)

fn main() !
    args := env.args()
    mut a := args
    if a.len() > 0 and a[0] == env.program()
        a = a.skip(1)
    cmd := a.first() else ""
    ok := match cmd
        "order" => a.len() == 1
        "cycles" => a.len() == 1
        "deps" => a.len() == 2
        "rdeps" => a.len() == 2
        _ => false
    if not ok
        usage()
        return
    mut g := Map[str, Set[str]]()
    mut bad := false
    text := io.read_all()
    mut k := 0
    for line in text.split("\n")
        k += 1
        if line.len() == 0 or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        parts := line.split(" -> ")
        if parts.len() == 1 and valid_name(parts[0])
            if not g.contains(parts[0])
                g[parts[0]] = Set[str]()
        elif parts.len() == 2 and valid_name(parts[0]) and valid_name(parts[1])
            if not g.contains(parts[0])
                g[parts[0]] = Set[str]()
            if not g.contains(parts[1])
                g[parts[1]] = Set[str]()
            mut s := g[parts[0]]
            s.insert(parts[1])
            g[parts[0]] = s
        else
            bad = true
            io.eprint("error: line {k}: bad line")
    names := g.keys().sorted()
    mut code := 0
    if cmd == "order"
        mut indeg := Map[str, int]()
        for n in names
            indeg[n] = 0
        for n in names
            for d in g[n].sorted()
                indeg[n] = indeg[n] + 1
        mut out := List[str]()

struct Tx
    date str
    account str
    amount int
    memo str

fn all_digits(s str) bool
    if s.len() == 0
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if not c.is_digit()
            return false
    true

fn valid_date(d str) bool
    if d.len() != 10
        return false
    cs := d.chars()
    for i in 0..10
        if i == 4 or i == 7
            if cs[i] != '-'
                return false
        elif not cs[i].is_digit()
            return false
    m := d.slice(5, 7).to_int() else return false
    dd := d.slice(8, 10).to_int() else return false
    m >= 1 and m <= 12 and dd >= 1 and dd <= 31

fn valid_amount(s str) bool
    if s.starts_with("-")
        return all_digits(s.slice(1, s.len()))
    all_digits(s)

fn fmt_parts(q int, r int) str
    mut qq := q + r / 100
    mut rr := r % 100
    if qq > 0 and rr < 0
        qq -= 1
        rr += 100
    elif qq < 0 and rr > 0
        qq += 1
        rr -= 100
    neg := qq < 0 or rr < 0
    a := qq.abs()
    b := rr.abs()
    sign := if neg then "-" else ""
    bs := if b < 10 then "0{b}" else "{b}"
    "{sign}{a}.{bs}"

fn fmt(a int) str
    fmt_parts(a / 100, a % 100)

fn usage()
    io.eprint("usage: ledger balance|top N|monthly\n")
    io.exit(1)

fn main() !
    args := env.args()
    mut rest := args
    if rest.len() > 0 and rest[0] == env.program()
        rest = args.slice(1, args.len())
    if rest.len() == 0
        usage()
    cmd := rest[0]
    mut n := 0
    if cmd == "top"
        if rest.len() != 2
            usage()
        if not all_digits(rest[1])
            usage()
        n = rest[1].to_int() else 
            usage()
            0
    elif cmd == "balance" or cmd == "monthly"
        if rest.len() != 1
            usage()
    else
        usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    mut lines := text.split("\n")
    if lines.len() > 0 and lines[lines.len() - 1] == ""
        lines.pop()
    if lines.len() == 0 or lines[0] != "date,account,amount_cents,memo"
        io.eprint("error: line 1: bad header\n")
        io.exit(2)
    mut txs := []
    mut bad := false
    for i in 1..lines.len()
        f := lines[i].split(",")
        if f.len() != 4
            io.eprint("error: line {i + 1}: wrong field count\n")
            bad = true
        elif not valid_date(f[0])
            io.eprint("error: line {i + 1}: bad date\n")
            bad = true
        elif f[1] == ""
            io.eprint("error: line {i + 1}: empty account\n")
            bad = true
        elif not valid_amount(f[2])
            io.eprint("error: line {i + 1}: bad amount\n")
            bad = true
        else
            amt := f[2].to_int() else
                io.eprint("error: line {i + 1}: bad amount\n")
                bad = true
                continue
            txs.push(Tx(date: f[0], account: f[1], amount: amt, memo: f[3]))
    if cmd == "top"
        keyed := txs.sorted(by: |t| 0 - mag(t.amount))
        for j in 0..keyed.len()
            if j < n
                t := keyed[j]
                print("{t.date}\t{t.account}\t{fmt(t.amount)}\t{t.memo}")
    else
        mut qs := {"": 0}
        mut rs := {"": 0}
        for t in txs
            k := if cmd == "balance" then t.account else t.date.slice(0, 7)
            qs[k] = qs.get(k) else 0
            rs[k] = rs.get(k) else 0
            qs[k] = qs[k] + t.amount / 100
            rs[k] = rs[k] + t.amount % 100
        qs.remove("")
        rs.remove("")
        for k in qs.keys().sorted()
            print("{k}\t{fmt_parts(qs[k], rs[k])}")
    if bad
        io.exit(2)

fn mag(a int) int
    if a >= 0
        return a
    m := a.wrapping_neg()
    if m < 0
        return 9223372036854775807
    m

    neg := c < 0
    mut q = c / 100

    for ch in s.chars()

            return false
    true

fn parse_line(line str) Tx ! str
    parts := line.split(",")
    if parts.len() != 4
        return "wrong field count"
    d := parts[0]
    if d.len() != 10 or d.slice(4, 5) != "-" or d.slice(7, 8) != "-"
        return "bad date"
    y := d.slice(0, 4)
    mo := d.slice(5, 7)
    dy := d.slice(8, 10)
    if not (all_digits(y) and all_digits(mo) and all_digits(dy))
        return "bad date"
    m := mo.to_int() else return "bad date"
    dd := dy.to_int() else return "bad date"
    if m < 1 or m > 12 or dd < 1 or dd > 31
        return "bad date"
    if parts[1].len() == 0
        return "empty account"

    if d.len() != 10

        return false
    mi := m.to_int() else return false
    di := dd.to_int() else return false
    mi >= 1 and mi <= 12 and di >= 1 and di <= 31

fn parse_line(line str) Tx ! str
    f := line.split(",")
    if f.len() != 4
        return "expected 4 fields"

        return "bad date"

        return "empty account"

        return "bad amount"

use std.env
use std.io
use std.bigint

struct Tx
    date str
    account str
    amount int
    memo str

fn usage()
    io.eprint("usage: ledger balance|top N|monthly")
    io.exit(1)

fn all_digits(s str) bool
    if s.is_empty()
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if not c.is_digit()
            return false
    true

fn fmt(v BigInt) str
    t := v.to_text()
    neg := t.starts_with("-")
    digits := if neg then t.slice(1, t.len()) else t
    padded := if digits.len() < 3 then digits.pad_left(3, '0') else digits
    n := padded.len()
    body := "{padded.slice(0, n - 2)}.{padded.slice(n - 2, n)}"
    if neg and digits != "0"
        "-{body}"
    else
        body

fn fmt_int(a int) str
    fmt(bigint.from_int(a))

fn date_ok(d str) bool
    if d.len() != 10
        return false
    if d.slice(4, 5) != "-" or d.slice(7, 8) != "-"
        return false
    y := d.slice(0, 4)
    m := d.slice(5, 7)
    dd := d.slice(8, 10)
    if not all_digits(y) or not all_digits(m) or not all_digits(dd)
        return false
    mi := m.to_int() else 0
    di := dd.to_int() else 0
    mi >= 1 and mi <= 12 and di >= 1 and di <= 31

fn parse_line(line str) Tx ! str
    parts := line.split(",")
    if parts.len() != 4
        return "expected 4 fields"
    if not date_ok(parts[0])
        return "bad date"
    if parts[1].is_empty()
        return "empty account"
    a := parts[2]
    body := if a.starts_with("-") then a.slice(1, a.len()) else a
    if not all_digits(body)
        return "bad amount"
    n := a.to_int() else return "bad amount"
    Tx(date: parts[0], account: parts[1], amount: n, memo: parts[3])

fn main() !
    args := env.args()
    if args.is_empty()
        usage()
    cmd := args[0]
    mut topn := 0
    if cmd == "top"
        if args.len() != 2
            usage()
        if not all_digits(args[1])
            usage()
        topn = args[1].to_int() else 9223372036854775807
    elif (cmd == "balance" or cmd == "monthly") and args.len() == 1
        topn = 0
    else
        usage()
    text := io.read_all()
    mut lines := text.split("\n")
    if lines.len() > 0 and lines[lines.len() - 1] == ""
        lines.pop()
    if lines.is_empty() or lines[0] != "date,account,amount_cents,memo"
        io.eprint("error: line 1: bad header")
        io.exit(2)
    mut txs := List[Tx]()
    mut bad := false
    for i in 1..lines.len()
        r := parse_line(lines[i])
        if tx := r
            txs.push(tx)
        else err
            io.eprint("error: line {i + 1}: {err}")
            bad = true
    if cmd == "balance"
        mut m := Map[str, BigInt]()
        for t in txs
            cur := m.get(t.account) else bigint.from_int(0)
            m[t.account] = cur.add(bigint.from_int(t.amount))
        for k in m.keys().sorted()
            print("{k}\t{fmt(m[k])}")
    elif cmd == "monthly"
        mut m := Map[str, BigInt]()
        for t in txs
            k := t.date.slice(0, 7)
            cur := m.get(k) else bigint.from_int(0)
            m[k] = cur.add(bigint.from_int(t.amount))
        for k in m.keys().sorted()
            print("{k}\t{fmt(m[k])}")
    else
        sorted := txs.sorted(by: |t| 0.saturating_sub(if t.amount < 0 then t.amount else 0 - t.amount))
        for t in sorted.take(topn)
            print("{t.date}\t{t.account}\t{fmt_int(t.amount)}\t{t.memo}")
    if bad
        io.exit(2)

struct Tx

    memo str
    mag int

struct Big
    hi int
    lo int

fn Big.add(mut self, a int)
    hi += a / 1000000000
    lo += a % 1000000000
    hi += lo / 1000000000
    lo = lo % 1000000000

fn digits_only(s str) bool
    if s.is_empty()
        return false
    for c in s.chars()
        if not c.is_digit()
            return false
    true

fn fmt_cents(digs str, neg bool) str
    d := if digs.len() < 3 then "0".repeat(3 - digs.len()) + digs else digs
    body := "{d.slice(0, d.len() - 2)}.{d.slice(d.len() - 2, d.len())}"
    if neg
        return "-{body}"
    body

fn strip_zeros(s str) str
    mut t := s
    while t.len() > 1 and t.starts_with("0")
        t = t.slice(1, t.len())
    t

fn fmt_big(b Big) str
    mut hi := b.hi
    mut lo := b.lo
    if hi > 0 and lo < 0
        hi -= 1
        lo += 1000000000
    elif hi < 0 and lo > 0
        hi += 1
        lo -= 1000000000
    neg := hi < 0 or lo < 0
    h := hi.abs()
    l := lo.abs()
    digs := if h == 0 then "{l}" else "{h}{l.to_str().pad_left(9, '0')}"
    fmt_cents(strip_zeros(digs), neg)

fn fmt_int(n int) str
    if n == 0
        return "0.00"
    mut b := Big(hi: 0, lo: 0)
    b.add(n)
    fmt_big(b)

fn usage()
    io.eprint("usage: ledger balance|top N|monthly")
    io.exit(1)

fn check(line str) str?
    parts := line.split(",")
    if parts.len() != 4
        return "expected 4 fields"
    d := parts[0]
    if d.len() != 10 or d.slice(4, 5) != "-" or d.slice(7, 8) != "-"
        return "bad date"
